tei:div.tei:p: "$ (47)༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i mchod chog nyer mkho bzhugs so//

(48)༄༅// oṃ swa sti pra dze bh+yaḥ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// skabs 'dir las dang po pa la nye bar mkho ba'i lag len 'di lta bu dag yod de/ de la gsum maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bdag 'jug dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya mchod pa'i cho ga'o// dang po ni/ bris sku la sogs pa rten dgram// maṇ+ḍal 'cha' ba bdag bskyed kyi rjes su byed pa thob thang yin yang*/ lag len stabs bde ba'i phyir skabs 'dir 'cha' na/ cho ga'i rdo rje slob dpon nam las kyi rdo rje slob dpon des/ rang skad cig gis dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur gyur/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nang mchod 'du byas byin gyis brlabs nas/ maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣa/ zhes brjod bzhin du maṇ+ḍal la nang mchod kyis byugs/ slar yang mtheb srin g.yon pas nang mchod nas blangs te/ maṇ+ḍal la chos 'byung gru gsum 'bri/ dbus su bdud rtsi'i thig le zlum po zhig bya/ de'i steng du spros pa la dga' na rdul tshon bkram ste/ chos 'byung dmar po/ gong ras ljang gu/ thig le dkar po bya/ mdor bsdus su byed na bdud rtsi'i thig le'i steng du 'bru'i tshom bu tsam 'god/ de dag gi mdun du mchod pa rgya cher bsham/ gtso bo'i zlum gtor gcig /sde drug la zur gsum re re/ gzhan yang chos skyong dang gzhi bdag gi gtor ma sogs ji ltar 'os pa bsham/ rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya'i mchod pa dang sbrel nas byed na/ de dang nye ba'i phyogs gang yang rung bar 'chad par 'gyur ba'i maṇ+ḍal dang mchod gtor rnams kyang 'du byas la skabs 'dir bsham pa'am/ 'og tu dus la babs pa'i tshe bsham pa gang bder bya'o// slob dpon gyi drung du nang mchod rdo dril cang te'u sogs tshogs par byas nas/ gzhan yang rol mo la sogs pa legs par (49) bstar te/ sngon 'gro gtor ma la chab btang*/ thog mar nang mchod la dmigs te/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hriḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bha wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes byin gyis brlab / oṃ āḥhūm̐ hriḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sarba dharma su bi shud+dha swa bhā wa sarba dharmā na bi sho dha ya swā hā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sūr+ya sarba dharma pra bo dha ka sarba dharmā na pra bo dha ya swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra a na la sarba dharma pra dī pa ka sarba dharmā na pra dī pa ya swā hā/ oṃ hoḥsarba dharma badz+ra a mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharmā na badz+ra a mṛ ta ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes sngags tshan bzhis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ phaiṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍa ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsa/ un mā da/ a pa smā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhu ñdza tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ pi pa tha mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarbā kā ra tā yā sad su kha bi shud+dha sa ha yi kāṃ/ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tī ts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ/ badz+ra dhu paṃ/ badz+ra dī paṃ/ badz+ra nai wi d+yaṃ/ badz+ra āk+ṣa taṃ/ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra hā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ/ badz+ra nṛ t+ye/ badz+ra gī taṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kā maṃ pra tī ts+tsha na maḥ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ (50)rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po// rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med// rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che// mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags=

/sha za'i= /smyo byed= /brjed byed= /mkha' 'gro'i= /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus ji snyed mchis pa rnams// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snams la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i mthar/ (51)oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣa hraḥhraḥhraḥhraḥ ra ra ra ra badz+ra a na la/ sarba ā pa ra ṇa dharma pra la ya swa bhā wa/ sarba mā ra kāṃ yi ka /bigh+nā bi nā ya ka ā dī nāṃ/ da sha di ka ga tā nāṃ/ kā ya wā k+tsit+tā naṃ/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bha smi ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces bdud bsreg pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ tshams rngams dang rol mo'i sgra bya// de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa// mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su shel gyi snod sor bcu gnyis pa rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥrnams las byung ba'i chu dang mchod yon dang*/ dri dang me tog dang bdug pa dang snang gsal dang*// zhal zas dam pa dag dang rnam pa mang po'i 'bras bu ma nyams pa dang*/

gos dang rgyan dang*/ ba dan dang bla bre la sogs pa dang*/ glu dang gar dang me long dang dril bu la sogs pa sil snyan gyi tshogs du ma dang*/ in+d+ra nī la la sogs pa rnam pa mang po'i rin po che dang*/ nang gi dam tshig rnams dang*/ dam tshig rnam pa bzhi'i rdzas la sogs pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu dpag tu med cing dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ de bzhin tu sbyar te/ badz+ra dhū paṃ/ badz+ra dī paṃ/ badz+ra ne wi d+yaṃ/ badz+ra a k+ṣa taṃ/ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra hā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra wa d+yaṃ/ badz+ra nraṃ t+yaṃ/ badz+ra gī taṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kā maṃ swā hā/ rel thon dang bcas te/ oṃ hoḥbadz+ra ghāṇ+ḍe sarba dharma e ka pradzñā dhā ni swā bha wa/ sarba ā ka re sarba dharma pra bo dha ni sarba dharma ṇa swa bhā wān pra bo dha ya pra bo dha ya swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de dag ni sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o// dngos gzhi la dang po bdag bskyed ni/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams (52)la/ zhes pa nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi thugs kar thim/ zhes pa'i bar lha dgu'i sgrub thabs su ji skad bshad pa bzhin bsgom par bya'o// de nas mdun bskyed mchod pa dang bcas pa ni maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod dngos yin pas de bya ste/ de yang bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rgyas bsdus gang bsgom yang rung*/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyas pa bsgom tshul dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rgyas par bshad pa'i mdun bskyed bsgrub tshul mchod bstod gtor ma dang bcas pa rnams mtha' rgyas su byed pa ni shin tu rgyas pa yin la/ yang cho ga de nyid thugs dkyil tsam la sbyar na'ang cung zad rgyas par 'gyur zhing*/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sam thugs dkyil sa bon tsam las bskyed na'ang cho ga 'bring por 'gyur ro// 'chad par 'gyur ba 'di ni bsdus pa yin la/

bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang yin yang de ma bsdus par de'i gzugs brnyan maṇ+ḍal la shar ba'i tshul gyis skad cig gis bskyed nas mchod pa byed pa ni shin tu bsdus pa yin no// 'on kyang 'di ltar lag len tu bya ste/ nang mchod kha gso ba tsam grub na legs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hraḥphaṭa nas a mṛ ta ku ru ku ru swā hā'i bar nang mchod byin rlabs rgyas pa gtor ma byin rlabs ltar bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣa/ zhes lan gsum la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung thig le dang bcas pa grub par mos pa tsam byas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ swā bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams la gnas pa'i ྷྐྵྨླྺྼྻྃ brtsegs pa'i yi ge yongs su gyur pa las 'byung ba rim brtsegs lhun po dang bcas pa'i steng du thugs gsung sku'i dkyil 'khor rnams mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa phyogs kun tu ye shes kyi 'od zer mtha' yas pa kun tu 'phro ba/ dbang po'i gzhu dang me long gi gzugs brnyan dang pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa/ rang gi sems nyid kyis so sor snang ba gzhom du med cing rdul phra rab kyi chos las 'das pa/ dwangs shing sgrib pa med la phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing (53)rgyan gyi rnam pa mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes pa/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa gnas thams cad du lha'i gdan thams cad kyis mdzes pa'o// gdan rnams kyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum/ nus ma bcu/ de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum bcu/ sems dpa' yab yum bcu gnyis/ khro bo khro mo brgyad/ gzung ma bcu gnyis te thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor ma brgyad thabs dang bcas pa rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba dang*/

'dod ma sum cu rtsa drug ste gsung gi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ lha chen po bcu gnyis so sor shes rab ma dang bcas shing*/ pad 'dab la gnas pa'i lha mo nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba/ tshes kyi lha sum brgya drug cu'i tshogs rnams dang*/ sgo skyong gi khro bo'i rgyal po drug po so sor yum dang bcas pa dang*/ phyir 'dod ma sum bcu rtsa drug dang*/ klu rgyal chen po bcu shes rab ma dang bcas pa ste/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzhal med khang la gnas pa rnams dang*/ dur khrod 'khor lor bzhugs pa'i rab gtum ma bcu thabs dang bcas pa dang*/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed dang so bzhi la sogs pa dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis grub par gyur pa ni/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bdag /srid gsum skye 'jig med pa'i dngos// shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku// dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal// rlung me chu dang sa yi dkyil 'khor lhun po pad+ma dang*// zla nyi dus me'i steng du dbang phyug dang ni bdud kyi mgor// zhabs ni srid pa'i yum gyi zhabs dang lhan cig bkod gyur pa// lha yi dbang pos btud pa'i gtso la spyi bor phyag 'tshal lo// zla ba'i sku dang zung gi zhabs te me yi mgrin pa chu gter dpal ldan zhal ni sna tshogs mdog /phrag ba drug dang nyi ma'i dpung pa rgyal ba'i phyag gi pad+mo stong pa drug dang me yi tshigs// zhabs dag (54)gis ni zla ba nyi ma sreg za'i dkyil 'khor dag la bdud dang drag po skrag bzhin pa// rol pas mnan pa'i srid med srid pa mnyam pa dus kyi 'khor lo gcig pu de la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum gri gug mda' dang lcags kyu ḍā ma ru// tho ba 'khor lo mdung dbyug dgra s+t+wa g.yas kyi phyag brgyad g.yon pa yang*// dril bu phub dang kha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa gzhu dang zhags pa rin po che// pad dkar dung dang me long lcags sgrogs tshangs mgos brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo// stag lpags dang ni rdo rje'i rgyan ldan rdo rje sku can bde ba che// 'od gsal stong nyid sna tshogs yum gyis kun nas rab 'khyud gser mdog ma// zhal bzhi phyag brgyad gri gug lcags kyu ḍā ma ru dang bgrang phreng dang*// thod pa zhags pa pad+ma dkar dang rin chen 'dzin mar bcas la 'dud// nag mo 'bar ma bdug spos tsan+dan gur gum dang ni ga bur snod// dril bu pad+ma yongs 'du'i me tog sna tshogs me tog phreng ldan ma// dmar mo'i g.yas na mar me do shal cod pan dang ni gdu bu ste// g.yon na gos dang ska rags dang ni rin chen rna rgyan rkang gdub 'dzin// dkar mo'i g.yas na 'o ma chu dang sman mchog chang gi snod rnams te// g.yon na bdud rtsi grub pa'i bcud dang bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu 'bras chen snod// ser mo 'bar ma dung dang gling bu nor bu dang ni ḍā ma ru// pi wang rnga dang 'khar rnga zangs dung rang phyogs gtso bo'i zhal ldan ma// de dag dang mtshungs du ba smrig rgyu me khyer dang ni mar me ma// rang mdog dang mtshungs rnga yab brgyad ldan phyag rgya lnga yis rnam brgyan ma// rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan dang ldan rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma// mnyam pa'i stabs can pha rol phyin rdzogs srog gi dkyil 'khor 'gags la 'dud// tshad med rnam thar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dbang dang bsnyen bsgrub dga' ba bzhis// lus ngag sems dang chags pa'i thig le gnas skabs rnam bzhi rnam dag pa// skad cig mkhyen pa sku dang rdo rje byang chub rnam bzhi sems dpa' bzhi// chos kyi dung dang gaṇ+ḍi nor du (55)dpag bsam shing la phyag 'tshal lo// khu khrag rkang dang khrag gi tshogs chen dri chen dri chu rab 'gags pa// 'chi med rab ster 'chi med rgyun gyis mngon par gang ba'i thod pa'am// zla ba'i rang bzhin zla ba'i 'od ltar rab tu dkar ba'i bum pa ni// bdud kyi tshogs 'joms bdud rtsi'i tshogs gyis shin tu gang ba rnams la 'dud// 'du byed rlung dang ngag gi dbang po sna dang reg gzhan 'dus ma byas// don yod sgrol ma bgegs kyi dgra dang nam mkha'i snying po reg bya ma// ral gri gri gug rtse gsum phub dang dpal ldan thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga

/nyi zla'i gdong ldan sprin nag dang mtshungs sa yi rigs kyis 'khyud la 'dud// tshor ba me dang lag pa'i dbang po mig dang ro gzhan bde ba che// rin chen dbang po gos dkar mo dang rmugs byed sa yi snying po'o// mda' dang lcags kyu ḍā ma ru dang gzhu dang zhags pa nor bu'i phyag /dkar nag gdong ldan nyin mor byed 'dra chu yi rigs kyis 'khyud la 'dud// 'du shes chu dang rkang pa'i dbang po lce dang gzugs gzhan ye shes sku// snang ba mtha' yas ma mā ki dang khengs byed 'jig rten dbang po'i gzugs// tho ba mdung dang rtse gsum pad kar me long dang ni bgrang phreng dang*// nag dang dmar ba'i gdong ldan dkar mo me yi rigs kyi 'khyud la 'dud// gzugs kyi phung po sa dang bshang lam lus dang dri gzhon 'od gsal gzugs// rtag pa spyan ma rengs byed dang ni rnam sel dri yi rdo rje ma// 'khor lo dbyug pa khro bo'i rdo rje dung dang lcags sgrog dril bu'i phyag /dkar nag gdong ldan gser gyi ri 'dra rlung gi rigs kyis 'khyud la 'dud// rna ba chos khams yid dang sgra gzhan phyag na rdo rje chos khams ma// kun bzang sgra yi rdo rje ma ste ljang sngon phan tshun yang dag sbyor// g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i zhal gyis rab brgyan rdo rje dril bu dgra s+t+wa dang*// dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i gdong ldan stong pa'i rigs la phyag 'tshal lo// rab dkar chu skyes mdangs bkra'i ze'u 'brur 'od (56)stong bdag po'i dkyil 'khor la// rdo rje'i gdan dang g.yas brkyang stabs bzhugs rgyal dang rgyal sras khro rgyal dang*// 'dam skyes dmar po'i ge sar snying por ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor la// pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs rig ma rnams dang rdo rje ma rnams la phyag 'tshal// de ltar lha yi 'khor lo legs mchod dri dang phreng ba bdug spos ma// snang gsal bdud rtsi 'bras bu ma dang sgeg mo bzhad ma sil snyan ma// gar dang glu yi sbyor ba la brtson 'dod ma 'dod la rab dga' ma// rgyan dang cha byad rnam 'gyur du mas yid rang 'dzin ma rnams bstod do// phyogs dang mtshams su chu skyes dmar dang dkar po la gnas rnal 'byor ma// lte ba'i rtsa brgyad drug cu rtsa bzhi rnam par dag pa'i chos can ma// thun tshod dang ni dbyug gu rnam dag kun nas bde la snyoms 'jug ma// spyan gsum phyag bzhi rol pas yongs bskor sa ga'i stabs kyis legs gnas ma// yi dwags la gnas tsa rtsi kā ni dbang pos 'khyud cing 'jig ma dang*// rlung shugs ma dang drag mo dus kyi mche ba ma dang me 'bar gdong*// rab gtum drag mig sna chen mas bskor dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs zla zhal ma// thams cad gri gug rtse gsum thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yis brgyan la 'dud// mkha' lding la gnas khyab 'jug ma ni tshangs pas 'khyud cing dpal mo dang*// rnam par rgyal ma sgyu ma grags ma bkra shis ma dang dpal rgyal ma// dpal rgyal byed ma 'khor lo mas bskor 'khor lo dbyug tho pad+ma dang*// dung gi phyag ldan sprin nag dang mtshungs zla ba'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo// ma her gnas pa'i phag mo la ni drag pos 'khyud cing keng rus ma// gcigs ma dus mtshan rab khros gdong ma dus kyi lce ma nag mo dang*// drag mo dang ni gzugs ngan mas bskor me yi mdog can zla zhal ma// dbyug pa ral gri lcags sgrog phub kyis rnam brgyan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rma byar gnas pa'i gzhon nu ma ni tshogs bdag gis 'khyud pad+ma ma// rin chen phreng ma lus med gzhon nu ri dwags bdag po'i 'gros (57)ma dang*// mig mdzes rul ma bzang mos yongs bskor byi ru'i 'od 'phro gdong drug ma// shaka ti lcags kyu rin chen zhags pas nye bar mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo// khyur mchog la gnas drag mo la ni gshin rjes 'khyud cing phyogs kun nas// gau ri 'degs ma gaṃ ga ma dang rtag ma myur ma mtshon byed ma// dmar ser ma dang nag mos yongs bskor zla ba'i mdog can zla ba'i zhal// rtse gsum cang te'u kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ltos 'gros mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo// seng ger gnas pa'i dpal mo la ni gzhon nus 'khyud cing dpal dkar mo// 'dzin ma zla ba'i ri mo can dang ri bong 'dzin zhal ngang pa'i mdog

/pad+ma'i dbang mo skar mig ma dang dri med ri bong 'dzin mas bskor// zla 'od zla zhal pad+ma bgrang phreng chu skyes rin chen 'dzin la 'dud// glang por gnas pa'i dbang mo la ni srin pos 'khyud cing rdo rje'i 'od// bkra ba'i ri mo rdo rje'i lus ma gser ldan ma dang ur ba sī// raṃ bha zug rngu med ma dang ni shin tu sgrol mas yongs bskor ma// gser mdog zla zhal rdo rje mda' dang dril bu gzhu yis mtshan la 'dud// ngang par gnas pa'i tshangs ma la ni nor lhas 'khyud cing mchod sbyin 'don// ngag gi dbang phyug pad+ma'i spyan mchu skyes ldan ma blo gros ma// glu ma glog ma dran mas yongs bskor rig byed gdong ma gser mdog ma// phyag gi pad+ma pad+ma tshangs dbyug spyi blugs par bus mtshan la 'dud// zla ba tshigs chen nyi ma'i tshes dang rtsa// rnam dag lha chen bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas// spyan gsum nyi zla'i mdog can pad+ma'i steng*// rol pas yongs bskor rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs pa// srin mos 'khyud cing yi dwags la gnas pa'i// bden bral la sogs nag pa'i tshes rnams gzhan// ral gri gri gug phub dang thod pa can// dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs zla ba'i zhal la 'dud// gtum mos 'khyud cing ri dwags la gnas pa'i// rlung sogs sa ga'i tshes gzhan dpag bsam shing*// yongs 'dus me tog nor bu (58)ut+pal 'dzin// zla zhal mig sman mdog la phyag 'tshal lo// lug la gnas shing chu bdag mos 'khyud pa'i// me lha la sogs snon gyi tshes rnams gzhan// mdung thung dbyug pa chu skyes spyi blugs 'dzin// zhal gcig pad+ma rā ga'i mdog la 'dud// dpal mos 'khyud cing rma bya la gnas pa'i// gdong drug la sogs chu stod tshes rnams gzhan// shakra ti mdung dang nor bu me long can// bye ru'i 'od 'phro gdong drug ldan pas skyongs// phag mos 'khyud cing chu srin la gnas pa'i// rgya mtsho la sogs gro bzhin tshes rnams gzhan// zhags pa rin chen sbrul zhags chu shel 'dzin// zla ba'i 'od can zla ba'i zhal mchod do// byi bar gnas shing gzhon nu mas 'khyud pa'i// tshogs bdag la sogs khrums stod tshes rnams gzhan// dgra sta rdo rje zhags pa nor bu'i phyag

/zla zhal zla 'od lta bur dkar la 'dud// glang por gnas shing rlung lha mos 'khyud pa'i// brgya byin la sogs tha skar tshes rnams gzhan// rdo rje mda' dang dril bu gzhu yis mtshan// gser mdog zla ba'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo// glog mas 'khyud cing ngang pa la gnas pa'i// tshangs pa la sogs smin drug chos rnams gzhan// khab dang bgrang phrang chu skyes spyi blugs 'dzin// chu yi gser mtshungs chu yi zhal gyis skyongs// u mas 'khyud cing khyu mchog la gnas pa'i// drag po la sogs mgo yi tshes rnams gzhan// rtse gsum mda' dang sbrul zhags kha ṭ+wāṃ gzhu// ri bong 'dzin zhal mkha' ltar sngo la 'dud// glang por gnas shing nor sbyin mos 'khyud pa'i// nor bdag la sogs rgyal gyi tshes rnams gzhan// nor bu be con ne'u le pad+ma'i phyag /sngon po ri dwags mtshan pa'i zhal mchod bgyi// dpal mos 'khyud cing mkha' lding la gnas pa'i// khyab 'jug la sogs mchu yi tshes rnams gzhan// 'khor lo dbyug tho pad+ma dung gis mtshan// zhal gcig ma rgad mdog la phyag 'tshal lo// gshin rje (59)mas 'khyud ma he la gnas pa'i// gshin rje la sogs dpe yi chos rnams gzhan// dbyug pa ral gri lcag sgrog zhags pas brgyan// ljang gu ri dwags can zhal la phyag 'tshal// 'od zer can 'khyud dbyug sngon nag po ral gri dang ni rdo rje phub dang lto 'gro 'dzin// tsun das legs 'khyud ṭā ki dmar po me mda' dang ni lcags kyu gzhu dang zhags pas mtshan// khro gnyer mas 'khyud mi g.yo dkar po tho ba dang ni mdung dang pad+ma me long 'dzin// lcags sgrog mas 'khyud stobs chen ser po 'khor lo dang ni dbyug pa dung dang nor bu'i phyag /sngon mos 'khyud pa'i gtsug tor ljang gu dgra sta dang ni rtse gsum sbrul zhags kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /drag spyan mas 'khyud gnod mdzes sngon po gri gug dang ni rdo rje thod pa dril bu 'dzin// phag rta seng ge glang po mkha' lding rkang brgyad kyis ni shing rta la gnas g.yas brkyang stabs// mthil bzhi gshang lam gtsug gi rtsa dag khro bo'i tshogs ni zhal gcig phyag bzhis brjid la 'dud// stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma char sprin mdog

/nor rgyas dung skyong bye ru'i phung po 'dra// mtha' yas rigs ldan kun da'i mdog ltar gsal// 'jog po pad+ma chen po rab tu ser// rgyal dang rnam rgyal ljang sngon 'byung ba la// rdo rje gdan bzhugs rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// bum pa rdo rje pad+ma nor bu'i phyag /rkang sor klu chen gtum mos 'khyud la 'dud// mdung gis 'bigs dang lhag ma bsregs pa'i ro// drag po'i g.yul dang rul pa byis pa gsod// rnag gi dri dang sbrul gyis zos pa yis// dur khrod chen por bse dang dhe ru ṇa ḍa// dom dang khrung khrung 'bri dang bya ma byi// seng ge mig sngon la gnas 'khor lo'i steng*// zlum po'i stabs can mi mgo'i phreng ldan ma// gcer bu spyan gsum gri gug thod pa ma// phyag rgya lnga ldan klu yis rab 'khyud ma// lus la lag pa'i sor mo rnam dag ma// khyi gdong ma dang khwa gdong phag gdong ma// bya rgod (60)gdong ma stag gdong 'ug gdong ma// lce spyang gdong ma nam mkha' lding gdong ma// steng 'og shing rta sngon mo rdo rje'i mig /skra dang ba spu rnam dag grub pa dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor la phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu stobs ma rmugs byed ma dang nga rgyal can ma rengs byed ma// lcags sgrog ma dang khro gnyer can ma tsun da dang ni 'od zer can// drag spyan ma dang shin tu sngon mo rang rang rigs kyi khro bo yi// zhal phyag mtshon cha kha dog rgyan ldan khro mo rnams la'ang phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin sgrol ma reg bya ma dang khyab 'jug lcags sgrog kha gdong ma// rab sngon rab brtson tsa rtsi kā dang khyi gdong mas bskyed brgya byin du// dbye ba gos dang mchil 'dor reg bya lhag ma za ba kun tu gdung*// sgrod dang lus 'phrugs yan lag bskyod par 'dod dang phyir 'dod ma la 'dud// gos dkar ro ma gzhon nu ma dang khro gnyer can ma bya rgod ma// drag spyan rmugs ma phag mo dang ni phag gdong mas bskyed lho phyogs su// bskyod pa zas dang gar 'gugs g.yul dang rgyug pa dang ni skem pa dang*// lus la dri ma bshang gci zag par 'dod dang phyir 'dod ma rnams mchod// ma mā ki dang gzugs ma dpal mo tsun da dang ni 'ug gdong ma// sgra ma khengs ma drag mo dang ni stag gdong mas bskyed nor sbyin tu// rgyas pa rgyan dang rgyal srid 'ching ba byis pa bsdigs dang rol mo'i sgra// 'jam par smra dang mal stan rtsod ma 'dod dang phyir 'dod ma rnams rgyal// spyan ma dri ma tshangs ma dang ni 'od zer can ma mkha' lding ma// chos kyi khams ma rengs ma dbang mo lce spyang mas bskyed chu bdag tu// rengs pa dri dang chu la rkyal pa phur bus 'debs dang sprul 'ching 'khrig

/gnyen 'dun mal bsnyes sems can bslu 'dod phyir 'dod ma rnams gzhan la 'dud// khyod ni srid pa gsum las 'das kyang srid pa gsum gyi rnam pa can// phra rab rdul gyi chos dang bral yang brtan dang g.yo ba kun gyi gzugs// lus dang dbang po'i sbyor ba spangs kyang (61)rtag tu 'dod chags che la rol// bsam gyis mi khyab brtag par dka' ba dus kyi 'khor los bdag skyongs shig /gza' dang drang srong rgyu skar khyim dang cha// phyogs skyong zhing skyong pho nya 'phrog ma dang*// ghāṇ+ḍa karna dga' byed nag po che// bhṛṃ gi ni sogs 'khor mang rgyal gyur cig /de ltar bstod pas phung po khams sogs gzhan// bde gshegs snying po de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings// blo bur dri ma'i spubs las nges grol te// srid gsum dwangs ba mngon du byed gyur cig

/ces bstod chen 'don bzhin tu lha rnams gsal gdab bo// de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab par bya ste// gong gi gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlab pa dang 'dra ba las/ gnas khang bskyed chog gi tshig dor ba ste/ stong pa'i ngang las shel gyi snod sor bcu gnyis pa/ zhes sogs brjod pa'i khyad par tsam mo// de nas mchod pa'i mgron spyan drangs nas mchod pa ni/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros// rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mchod pa'i yul du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥtrai dhā tu ke shwa ra kā la tsa kra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sa pa ri wā ra twaṃ bha ga wān me wa ra do bhā wa shi ṣ+yā ni tsa/ zhes pa lan gsum/ /rnam dag ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu gter ni// rab dwangs kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs// zhal gyi rnyogs pa'i dri sel yon chab 'di// dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ āḥhri pra wa ra sad ka raṃ ār+tha āñtsa ma naṃ pa tits+tsha na maḥ /rnam dag ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu gter ni// rab dwangs kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs// zhabs kyi pad+ma'i dri sel spos kyi chu// dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// oṃ āḥhri pra war sad ka raṃ ar+thaṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ tshig rkang dang po gnyis dang phyi ma 'dra ba'o/ /rnam dag ye shes= /rab dngas= /kun tu 'pho ba'i gdung sel 'thor 'thung 'di// (62)dus kyi 'khor lo'i= oṃ āḥhri pra wa ra sad ka raṃ ar+thaṃ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rnam dag ye shes= /rab dwangs kha dog= /yan lag brgyad ldan rdo rje ar+ghaṃ'i rgyun// dus kyi 'khor lo'i= oṃ āḥhri pra wa ra sad ka raṃ ar+thaṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes pas chu bzhi phul/ /khams gsum dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das// dus kyi 'khor lo 'khor bcas rnams// rnam dag rdo rje'i dri mchog 'di// bzhes nas bdag la mchog stsol mdzod// oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wa re bh+yaḥ

badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /rkang pa gsum yang snga ma bzhin kun la sbyar te/ /khams gsum dbang phyug= /dus kyi 'khor lo= /rdo rje me tog rnam bkra'i tshogs// bzhes nas= badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tī ts+tsha na maḥ khams gsum= /dus kyi= /rdo rje bdug spos bla na med// bzhes nas= /badz+ra dhū paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ khams gsum= /dus kyi= /rdo rje sgron ma 'od rab 'bar// bzhes nas= /badz+ra dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /khams gsum= /dus kyi 'khor= /rdo rje zhal zas ro mchog ldan// bzhes nas= /badz+ra nai wi d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /khams gsum= /dus kyi= /rdo rje ma nyams 'bras bu'i mchog /bzhes nas= /badz+ra āk+ṣa taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /khams gsum= /dus kyi= /rdo rje sgeg mo'i mchod pa ni// bzhes nas= /badz+ra lā s+ye pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /khams gsum= /dus kyi= /rdo rje bzhad ma'i mchod pa 'di// bzhes nas= /badz+ra hā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /khams gsum= /dus kyi= /rdo rje sil snyan rnam mang po// bzhes nas= /badz+ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /khams gsum= /dus kyi= /rdo rje gar gyi mchod sprin 'di// bzhes nas= /badz+ra nṛ t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /khams gsum= /dus kyi= /rdo rje glu dbyangs yid 'phrog ldan// bzhes nas= /badz+ra gī taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /khams gsum dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das// dus kyi 'khor lo 'khor bcas rnams// rdo rje 'dod pa'i mchod pa mchog /bzhes nas bdag la mchog stsol mdzod// badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ /(63)tsa sde thung ring las skyes pa'i// dri chab mo dang phreng ba mo// nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs sprul nas// dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul// oṃ ྩྪྫྫྷྙ badz+ra gan+dhe gan+dha a rtsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྩྪྫྫྷྙཱ badz+ra mā le mā la a rtsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྚྛྜྜྷྞ badz+ra dhū pe dhū pa a rtsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྚྛྜྜྷྞཱ badz+ra pra dī pe pra dī ba a rtsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/

oṃ ྤྥྦྦྷྨ badz+ra āmṛ te ni wi d+ya pū dzī ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྤྥྦྦྷྨཱ badz+ra āk+ṣa te āk+ṣa ta phal ārtsa na ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྟྠྡྡྷྣ badz+ra la s+ye wasta ā bhar ṇa pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྟྠྡྡྷྣཱ badz+ra hā s+ye ghāṇ+ḍa ā dar+ṣa pū dzā+e ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྐྑྒྒྷྔ badz+ra wā d+ye bā d+ya pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྐྑྒྒྷྔཱ badz+ra nṛ t+ye nṛ t+ya pū dzā ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྶny+p+ṣ+shaྈྐ badz+ra gī te gī ta pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྶny+p+ṣ+shaྈྐཱ badz+ra kā me sarba bud+dha bodhi sa twa nāṃ kro dha ā dī nāṃ badz+ra sū ra ta pū dzā ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes reg ma bcu gnyis kyi mchod/ /srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku brnyes la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /ra ba'i bar nor bu rin chen in+d+ra rnyil// gser dngul la sogs rin chen me tog dang*// rig ma bde ba rnam ma dgos kyi tshogs// tsan+dan la sogs dri bzang (64)sbyar ba'i chab// dri zhim bdug spos bsreg pa'i sprin tshogs dang*// rtsi bcud 'bru mar dang bcas sgron me'i tshogs// grags stong gnyis su med pa dril bu'i sgra// gsal snang gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i me long dang*// lha rdzas bla bre nam mkha'i tshad 'jal byed// rnam mang 'bras bu sna tshogs bcud ster zhing*// lhab lhub g.yo ba ba dan rnam lnga'i tshogs// 'jo sgeg rnam 'gyur spro ba'i gar mkhan dang*// sgra snyan sna tshogs rol mo'i mchod pa ste// bcu gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// yan lag bcu gnyis 'pho ba rab 'gags nas// bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /rab dwangs yan lag brgyad ldan chu gtsang dang*// 'o chab me tog bcas pa'i mchod yon bzang*// rlung gis bskyod pa'i dri bzang mkha' khyab dang*// lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i bdug spos dang*// ut+pal pad+ma la sogs me tog bkra// ma nyams sa hā ka ra'i 'bras bu smin// sman mchog dbang po la sogs 'bru sna tshogs// nyi zla nor bu la sogs snang gsal tshogs// bdud rtsi ro brgya ldan pa'i lha bshos dang*// pañtsa li kā lha yi gos kyi mchog

/mchod pa rnam bcu phul bas sa bcu thob// dkyil 'khor rnam bcu sgrib bral thob par shog /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la// bkra shis dpal be'u g.yung drung 'khyil// dge ba'i don tu mnga' ba ltar// de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi// ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la// gser gyi 'khor lo mu khyud can// tshangs pa chen pos phul ba ltar// de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi// ji ltar= /'dam gyis skyon gyis ma gos pa'i// pad+ma dkar po phul ba ltar// de bzhin= /ji ltar sngon= /nyon mongs bdud las rgyal ba yi// chos kyi rgyal mtshan phul ba ltar// de bzhin= /ji ltar= /gdugs dkar gser gyi yu ba can// phul ba de bzhin bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// ji ltar= /re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa'i// (65)bum pa bzang po phul ba ltar// de bzhin= /ji ltar= /snyan pa phyogs bcur sgrog pa yi// 'bung dud g.yas 'khyil phul ba ltar// de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi// ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la// na bza' gser gyi nya ris can// phul ba de bzhin bdag 'bul na// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// phyogs las rnam rgyal gser gyi 'khor lo dang*// dgos 'dod ma lus stsol ba'i yid bzhin nor// gzugs mdzes skyon kun bral ba btsun mo'i mchog /bang mdzod ma lus 'gengs byed blon po'i phul// yid 'ong stobs ldan glang po'i bdag po dang*// cang shes sprin gyi shugs can rmad byung rta// rgol ba kun 'joms khyim bdag dpa' bo che// de ltar rin chen bdun gyis dkyil 'khor mchod// dri med chos kun gsal ba'i me long dang*// g.yas 'khyil chos sgra mi zad sgrog pa'i dung*// dug gsum nyon mongs 'joms pa'i gi haṃ dang*// rtsi bcud snying po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zho// khams gsum dbang du sdud pa li khri'i rdzas// rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe sgrub dūr ba'i rtsa// don mchog bla med sgrub pa bil ba'i 'bras// bgegs dang bar chad kun 'joms yungs dkar te// rgyal bas byin brlabs bkra shis rdzas brgyad po// phul bas 'gro la dge legs 'phel bar shog

/nyon mongs ma lus gcod pa'i stag lpags dang*// sgrib pa kun bal glang chen lpags pa'i gos// 'jigs byed he ru ka dpal mnyes byed pa// sna tshogs na bza'i mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi// dbang sngon ka rke ta na chu shel dang*// pad+ma rā ga mar gti mu tig dang*// dzam bu chu bo'i gser dang dngul la sogs// bza' dang bca' ba rnam pa du ma dang*// rtsa ba sdong bu 'dab ma me tog dang*// ljon shing la sogs rnam pa sna tshogs pa// bsod nams spel phyir dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// ral gri khang pa lpags pa skyed mos tshal// mal cha gos dang mchil lham (66)rin po che// pad+ma can sogs bkra shis lha mo brgyad// sna tshogs rin chen las grub khang bzang dang*// dpag bsam shing dang bum pa bzang po dang*// 'dod 'jo'i ba dang rin chen ri bo sogs// mchod sprin rgya mtshos dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// kun tu rab tu khyab byed dri bzang dang*// rnam dag nyi mas dag byed me tog phreng*// don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// 'gro bas rnam dag zla nyi thob par shog /gtum mo 'bar bas kun rtog bsregs pa'i spos// snying nang gzhom med 'bar ba'i snang gsal tshogs// don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// spros bral ye shes snang ba thob par shog /'dod yon gzhan mchog bdud rtsi zhal zas lnga// thig le nor bur bcings pa'i ma nyams 'bru// don dam= /stong pa'i gzugs kyi byang sems 'ching bar shog /ma dag gnas gyur ye shes sgeg mo'i lus// las rlung dhū tir thim pa bzhad sgra'i dbyangs// don dam= /rdo rje'i sku dang bcu gnyis sa thob shog /gzhom med nā da'i sil snyan rol mo mchog /rnam gsum phyag rgya'i rol pa bde ga'i gar// don dam= /grags stong sgra dang sgyu rtsal mchog thob shog /sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho chos nyid rdo rje'i glu// mi 'gyur bde sgrub phyag chen 'dod pa mo// don dam=

/rdo rje'i gsung dang mi 'gyur bde thob shog /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ /lan gsum la sogs pa ci rigs par brjod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ /na mo sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun thams cad kyi ngo bo// dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po// lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi skyob pa drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'di zhes bya ba'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// oṃ āḥhūm̐// dngos grub rgya mtsho yon tan rin chen gter// srid dang zhi ba'i gdung ba sel ba'i slad// lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs// (67)dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang la mchod pa 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐// nyi ma'i 'od dang zla bzang lha dbang dang*// gzi brjid zlas byin lha yi dbang phyug dang*// sna tshogs gzugs dang lha yi dbang ldan te// chos rgyal chen po brgyad la mchod pa 'bul// 'jam dbyangs grags pa pad+ma dkar po dang*// bzang po rnam rgyal bshes gnyen bzang po dang*// phyag na rin chen khyab 'jug sbas pa dang*// nyi ma grags dang shin tu bzang po mchod// rgya mtsho rnam rgyal rgyal dka' nyi ma dang*// sna tshogs gzugs dang zla 'od mtha' yas dang*// sa skyong dpal skyong seng ge rnam gnon dang*// stobs chen ma 'gags mi yi seng ge mchod// dbang phyug chen po mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang*// drag po zhes bya nyi shu rtsa lnga po// sa yi 'khor lo rdzogs par skyong ba ste// tshangs pa lha dbang phyed phyed skyong rnams mchod// 'od srung la sogs dum bur skyong ba brgyad// de ltar sa skyong sum cu rtsa lnga ni// rigs kun gcig tu byed pa gsang sngags kyi// rigs ldan brgyud pa rnams la mchod pa 'bul// dus zhabs gnyis dang na len+d+ra pa dang*// zla ba mgon po 'bro ston lo tsā dang*// lha rje sgom pa sgro ston gnam brtsegs dang*// grub chen yu mo rnams la mchod pa 'bul// chos kyi dbang phyug nam mkha' 'od zer dang*// sprul sku jo 'bum grub thob se chen dang*// chos rje 'jam gsar chos sku 'od zer dang*// kun spang chos rje rnams la mchod pa 'bul// byang sems chen po yon tan rgya mtsho dang*// kun mkhyen chos rje sgra bsgyur sku mched dang*// phyogs las rnam rgyal nya dbon chos rje dang*// grub chen kun blo rnams la mchod pa 'bul// 'jam dbyangs dkon bzang nam mkha' chos skyong dang*// nam mkha' dpal bzang rat+na bha dra dang*// grol mchog zhabs dang lung rigs rgya mtsho mchod// kun dga' snying po rin chen rgya mtsho ba// blo gros rnam rgyal (68)ngag dbang phrin las dang*// kun bzang dbang po tshe dbang nor bu mchod// 'jam mgon bla ma chos kyi 'byung gnas zhabs// bka' brgyud gdung 'tshob phrin las rnam par rgyal// dang po'i sangs rgyas pad+ma nyin mor byed// dharmā ka ra nas brgyud srol lugs gcig tshe dbang kun khyab dbang rgyal rdo rje mchod// gtsug lag chos rgyal theg mchog rdo rje'i zhabs// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen te// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mngon sum ston mdzad pa'i// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul// oṃ kā la tsakra ya hūm̐ swā hā/

oṃ āḥhūm̐// oṃ bi shwa mā twa hoḥphraiṃ swā hā// oṃ a āḥ.aṃ aḥha ha ham̐ ha swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ.a ā i ī ṛ ṝ u ū l̥ l̥̄ ha hā hi hī hṛ hṝ hu hū hl̥ hl̥̄ haṃ haḥ.a ā e ai ar ār o au a la ā la ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi yi bdag nyid dang*// tshad med rnam thar chos kyi phung po dang*// dam chos ston pa 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams te// skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa 'bul// dus 'khor rdor sems shākya thub pa dang*// nus ma bum pa bcu dang rdo rje bzhi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dang khro bo'i rgyal// rang rang lha mor bcas pa rnams la mchod// gzungs ma rnal 'byor ma dang 'dod ma dang*// tshes kyi lha dang gdengs can phyir 'dod ma// rab gtum gza' skar phyogs skyong zhing skyong sogs// phyed bcas bye ba gsum gyi 'byung po mchod// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas dang*// mchod yul rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul// 'gro kun ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho la// mchog tu rol pas bde chen thob par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bodhi sa twe bh+yo ཿna mo na maḥ gzhan yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad la mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bka' sdod chos skyong srung ma thams cad la 'bul lo// yul (69)bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad la 'bul lo// zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshims nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig

/bstod pa ni/ rol chen dang bcas te/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud// stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// med pa las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud// nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud// ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud// thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud// ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /ces mtshan brjod kyi 'dud nyi shus bstod// de nas dril gsil dang bcas te/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can// srid gsum skye 'jig med pa'i dngos// shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku// dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal// phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das// phra phab pa yi rang bzhin can// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan ma// phyag rgya chen mo de la 'dud// dus kyi 'khor lo bde chen po// sku gsum mchog dang dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje gsum mchog rdo rje dbyings// 'gyur ba med la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam rtog sgom pa las 'das pa// phyag rgya chen po mi 'gyur bde// gzung pa 'dzin pa dbyings dag dang*// rtog dang dpyod pa rnam par spangs// dri za'i grong khyer rnam pa dang*// pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can// shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid sbyor// e waṃ yi ge de la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi skyed mdzad ma// skye ba dang ni 'jig (70)pa spangs// kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa can// sna tshogs yum de la phyag 'tshal// ā li kā li snyoms 'jug dang*// hūm̐ phaṭa yi ge sogs spangs kyang*// 'gyur ba med las 'khrungs pa'i sku// dus kyi 'khor lo de la 'dud// kun mkhyen ye shes sku zhes pa// khyab rtag nyi ma lta bu'i sku// pad+ma 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan// de nyid bcu drug dbye ba las// sku bzhi'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas ni// rdo rje seng ge'i gdan bzhugs pa// lha dang lha min gyis bstod sngon// zla bzang gis gsol de la 'dud// rnam par bcas kyang rnam med bcom 'das ma shes rab ma ste de yis 'khyud// skye 'jig spangs pa'i 'gyur med bde ba dang ldan rgod pa la sogs bde ba spangs// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsum rnams dang ldan zhing dus gsum yang dag rig

/kun mkhyen mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan gnyis med de nyid la phyag 'tshal// gang la thog mtha' dbus med gnas dang 'chi dang sred pa dang ni sgra dang dri dang ro dag dang*// reg bya gzugs dang sems med rang bzhin dang ni skyes bu med cing 'ching dang grol dang byed po med// sa bon dang ni gsal bar dus med mtha' dag srid pa'i sdug bsngal bde ba nyid kyi rang bzhin med// mya ngan 'das pa mtshan ma med cing byed pa rnams phral yon tan med pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// dus dang sna tshogs la sogs rdo rje dang ni skyes bu dpe med kun 'gro spros pa med pa ste// ther zug tu gnas snyan dang shangs dang zhal dang spyan dang dbu dang phyag dang zhabs ni thams cad pa// 'byung po'i mtha' ste 'byung po'i mgon po mchog gi srid pa gsum 'dzin rgyud rnams dag gi rgyur gyur pa// rig pa la sogs rnal 'byor dag gis rtogs bya mchog bde'i go 'phang dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal// spro byed nus ma'i gzugs gzhan glog gi me dang mtshungs shing nyi ma bcu gnyis dag gi gzi brjid can// ye shes rdo rje'i snang ba mchog gi go 'phang bgrod byed rnam par bcad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// dkar po 'jig (71)rten gsum gyi mgon po ri bong 'dzin pa las 'dzag 'jig rten spyi bor yang dag gnas// bdud rtsi 'chi ba sel zhing srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byed pa thig le'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo// sems tsam sngags kyi ngo bo lha yis yongs su bskor ba sdug bsngal dang ni bde ba'i rang bzhin te// dam pa rnams la zhi ba'i gzugs ni rang gis byas pa'i nyams myong mi zad rnams la mi zad pa// gang gis las gang rab byas rang gi sems la cho ga bzhin tu de yi 'bras bu de bskyed pa// 'jig rten dbang po sna tshogs gzugs can srid gsum skyed mdzad rdo rje sems dpa' la yang phyag 'tshal lo// gcig dang du ma dag kyang gcig cing mnyam dang mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab dang*// steng 'og kun nas dkar ljang sna tshogs kha dog chen po gcig gi gzugs te thung du ring po dang*// shin tu rin po yon tan med ces yon tan dang bcas bud med skyes pa'i ma skyes pa bud med min// gang zhig kun gyi rten gcig bha ga bzang mo mchog gi bha ga khyod la 'dud de khyod la 'dud/

/ces pa la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pas bstod// de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi bdag 'jug mi byed na// skabs 'dir sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar gtor ma phul la rjes kyi cho ga rnams bya'o// gnyis pa bdag 'jug byed par 'dod na/ thog mar bum pa sgrub dgos pas bum pa sgrub tshul ni// bum pa bcu'am lnga la sogs pa yod na'ang legs la/ bsdu na bum pa gcig nyid la bum pa bcur mos pas chog ste/ bum pa'i steng du rnam rgyal chen po zhes bya ba dung chos bkod/ gzungs thag sogs kyang spyi dang mthun par lag len la mdzad do/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hraḥphaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ swa bha wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las haṃ hām̐ hiṃ hīṃ hṛṃ hṝṃ hum̐ hūṃ h+liṃ h+līṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las// dbus su khu ba dang rdul 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ shar dang mer rkang 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ lho dang ba dan bral du khrag 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ byang dang dbang ldan du gci ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ nub dang rlung du gshang ba 'gags pa'i bum pa (72)gnyis te bdud rtsi'i bum pa dkar po pad+ma la gnas shing pad+mas kha brgyan pa rnams su gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla ba sgra gcan gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las dus kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i yab kyi thugs kar zla ba dang*/ yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor te// de dag kha sbyar ba las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rdo rje'i bdud rtsi'i bum pa rnams dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ haṃ hāṃ hiṃ hīṃ hṛṃ hṝṃ huṃ hūm̐ hl̥ṃ hl̥̄ṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sta ṭa su bi shud+dha dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa sarba dharmā na su bi shud+dha dharmā dhā tu swa bhā wān ku ru ku ru swā hā/

zhes pa mang du bzlas/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ nas/ kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes pa'i bar mchod pa bcu gnyis 'bul/ /de dag ni bum pa sgrub pa'i cho ga'o// de nas/ lhag gnas kyi don tu maṇ+ḍal phul// skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi// chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba// 'khor ba'i mtsho las bdag sgrol mdzod// dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig pu/ byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /ces lan gsum/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /zhes pa len gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bzung*/ /sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// dus ni 'di nas bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// (73)byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog

/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgal// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣa badz+ra dan ta kāṣ+ṭha tsa tu ra bi mok+ṣa mu kha bi shud+dhe swa bhā wa kā ya wāka tsit+ta dzñā na mu kha dan+ta ā dī ma laṃ bi shwo dha bi shwa dha ya swā hā/ rang gi dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la āḥ snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la hūm̐/ lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la hoḥ gtsug gtor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la haṃ/ gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la k+ṣa rnams su gyur/ oṃ a ā aṃ aḥbadz+ra sa (74)twa ma hā su kha kā la tsakra badz+ra shiṣ+ya s+ya ā bhi mu kho ta bha wa san+tu ṣ+ṭo bha wa ba ra de bha wa kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a dhiṣ+ṭha naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum la sogs pa brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya ste rdo rje sems dpa' bskul ba'o/ /dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don tu maṇ+ḍal phul// mi bzad 'khor bas 'jigs pa bdag ni de ring nyid nas rgyal po rnams la skyabs su lhag par mchi// khyod kyi zhabs kyi chu skyes nges par srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog dag la lus ngag sems ni dag pas so/ /lan gsum/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bla ma dag kyang spyi bor bzung bar bgyi// rin chen la ni sbyin pa sbyin bgyi 'khor lo 'di la rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig bskyang bar bgyi// ral gri la ni mchod pa bgyi ste gsal bar chu skyes rigs la sdom pa dag kyang bskyang bar bgyi// sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du rgyal ba skyed mdzad rigs la byang chub bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ

sogs gong bzhin bkod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdud rtsi myang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo'i dbang po btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs te rang gi snying gar thim/ oṃ āḥr ra ra ra la la la la badz+ra ā be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te ye shes dbab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ 'tshe dang mi bden gzhan gyi bud med spang bya gzhan gyi nor dang chang gi btung ba de bzhin nyid// 'khor bar rdo rje'i zhags pa dag ste rang gi dge ba 'joms byad sdig pa lnga po 'di rnams so// gang zhig gang gi dus su byung ba'i lha dang mi yi bla ma de yi mtshan gyis rab sbyin bya// sna tshogs gtso bo'i bka' 'dis srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa dag ste khyod kyis kyang ni bskyang bar bya// cho lo kha na ma thos cas pa'i zas dang tshig ngan klog dang 'byung po lha min dbang po'i chos// ba lang byis pa bud med skyes pa rnams dang lha mi'i bla ma gsod pa lnga ni mi bya'o// grogs po rje bo rnams dang lha dang mi yi bla ma dge 'dun yid brtan rnams la (75)'khu ba yang*// dbang po rnams ni kun nas chags pa dag ste de ltar srid pa'i bdag po'i brtul zhugs nyi shu lnga/ /zhes tshar gcig brjod/ /srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms mdzad pa'i// brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga po// sna tshogs gtso bo'i gsung ji bzhin// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ lan gsum/ /oṃ dwā da sha aṃ ga ni ro dha kā ri ṇe hūm̐ phaṭa/ mig dar bcing zhing gos ser po bgos par mos/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ lan gcig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan bdun/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ku la bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes me tog phul bar mos/ oṃ de byā ne trī yā n+yu ṭa ghā ṭa swā hā/ oṃ di bya na mu da ghā ṭa yā mi swā hā/ zhes mig dar phye bas dkyil 'khor mthong bar mos// de nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dgu ma phul/ /bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs bcas// rin chen maṇ+ḍal kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa// blo yis blangs nas bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

ces brjod/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros// dbang gi lha 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ nas kā ma pra tīts+tsha na maḥ oṃ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /sogs kyang brjod/ /sgrib pa kun spangs dus kyi 'khor lo dang*// bla ma dbyer med ye shes sku khyod la// phyi nang mchod rdzas bzang dgu 'bul bar bgyi// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dbang rab stsol/ /ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ dung chos kyi chus gnas lngar gtor/ oṃ a i ṛ u l̥ pañtsa dhā tu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ khams lnga sbyong byed ye shes bdud rtsi 'dis// gnas lngar dbang bskur rang bzhin gnyug (76)ma yi// gshegs ma yul lnga'i dngos grub myur rtogs nas// 'bras bu sa ni dang po thob gyur cig /oṃ a i ṛ u l̥ pañtsa ta thā ga ta pa ri shud+dha swā hā/ phung po lnga rnams sbyong byed cod pan 'dis// gnas lngar dbang bskur rang bzhin gnyug ma yi// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dngos grub myur rtogs nas// 'bras bu sa ni gnyis pa thob gyur cig /oṃ a ā aṃ aḥha hā haṃ haḥphraiṃ ho da sha pa ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ṇi swā hā/ rlung bcu sbyong byed dar dpyangs phreng ba 'dis// gnas lngar dbang bskur rang bzhin gnyug ma yi// nus ma bcu yi dngos grub myur rtogs nas// 'bras bu sa ni gsum pa thob gyur cig /oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥsūr+ya tsan+d+ra bi sho dha ka swā hā// ro rkyang sbyong byed rdo rje dril bu 'dis// gnas lngar= /gtso bo yab yum dngos grub= /'bras bu sa ni bzhi pa= /oṃ a ā ai ai ar ār o au a la ā la/ bi ṣa ya in+d+ra ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/

dbang yul sbyong byed me tog sil ma 'dis// gnas lngar= /sems dpa' yab yum dngos grub= /'bras bu sa ni lnga pa= /oṃ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā tsa tu r+b+wah+ma bi hā ra bi shud+dhe swā hā/ kyai dpal brjod cing gsang ba'i ming dran pa rang bya/ las dbang bya ba sbyong byed gdu bu 'di// gnas lngar= /khro bo yab yum dngos grub= /'bras bu sa ni drug pa= /oṃ haṃ k+ṣa dharma tsakra pra war+dha ka swā hā/ 'gyur bde sbyong byed chos kyi 'khor lo 'dis// gnas lngar= /rdor sems yab yum dngos grub= /'bras bu sa ni bdun pa= /slar yang rang gi lag tu rdo rje dang dril bu sbyin par gyur/ nges par rdo rje'i rigs dag la ni srog gcod bya ste ral gri la yang bden pa min pa'i tshig /rin chen la ni gzhan nor dbrog bya mchog gi pad+ma'i rigs nyid la yang gzhan gyi bud med dbrog /chang dang sgron ma sangs rgyas rnams dang bzang po'i yul rnams mtha' dag 'khor lo la ni bskyod par bya// g.yung mo la sogs mtha' dag bud med rnams ni gri gug la yang mkha' yi pad+mar smad mi bya// sems can don gyi slad du nor dang bcas pa'i lus 'di sbyin par bya ste khyod kyis bzung mi bya// rigs kyi bu kye (77)sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba gzhan du mtha' yas bskal pas min par rgyal bas gsungs/

/zhes brjod/ de nas dam tshig rnams dran par bya ste/ gal te g.yo sgyu'i dbang gis rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung na dmyal bar 'gro ste 'di dag sdug bsngal lo// dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dkrug pas ni bu rnams kyi ni rtsa ba'i ltung ba ri bong 'dzin par 'gyur// de yi bka' la 'gongs pas gzhan tu 'gyur te nges par de bzhin spun la khros pas gsum pa'o// byams pa btang bas bzhi par 'gyur te byang chub sems ni rab tu nyams pa las kyang mda' ru 'gyur// drug pa grub pa'i mtha' la smod pa ri bo dag kyang ma smin mi la gsang ba sbyin las so// phung po nyon mongs pa las glu ru 'gyur te slar yang dgu pa dag pa'i chos la ma dad gang*// rgyu yi byams pa dang ni ming sogs bral ba'i bde ba ster la rtog pa phyogs dang drag po'o// dag pa'i sems can dag la skyon brjod pa las nyi ma dam tshig thob pa gtong ba las kyang gzhan// bud med thams cad la smod nges par ma nur 'gyur te rdo rje'i theg par gnas pa rnams la'o/ /zhes brjod/ dbang gong ma'i don tu gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ /sgrib pa thams cad bcom pa yi// dus kyi 'khor lo khyod la 'dud// mchog tu mi 'gyur bdes gang ba// ye shes sku khyod la phyag 'tshal// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// byang chub sems ni 'gyur med gang*// dbang bskur de yis bdag la ni// mgon po da ni bka' drin mdzod// bu dang chung ma sogs bcas pa// bdag ni dus kun khyod kyi 'bangs// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// bdag la skyabs gzhan yod ma yin/ /ces dbang gong ma spyir gsol ba btab/ oṃ oṃ pradzñā u pā yau ka la sha a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā tāṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa// sad pa'i gnas skabs sbyong byed bum dbang gis// dge tshul rdo rje 'dzin par dbang bskur pas// sgyu 'phrul drwa bas mngon par byang chub ste// 'bras bu sa ni brgyad pa thob gyur cig

/oṃ āḥpradzña u pā yau gu h+ya a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā taṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems myong zhing gsang (78)ba'i dkyil 'khor mthor bar gyur/ rmi lam gnas skabs sbyong byed gsang dbang gis// dge slong rdo rje 'dzin par dbang bskur bas// rnam pa nyi shus mngon par byang chub ste// 'bras bu sa ni dgu pa thob par shog /oṃ hūm̐ pradzña u pā yo badz+ra sa twa bi shwa mā ta rau pradzña dzñā na a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā taṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lag bcang dang gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba 'pho med du myong bar gyur/ oṃ dzñā na pū dza a nu rak+to swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ gnyid 'thug gnas skabs sbyong byed gsum pa 'dis// gnas brtan rdo rje 'dzin par dbang bskur bas// rnam pa lnga yis mngon par byang chub ste// 'bras bu phyogs dang drag po'i sa thob shog /bcom ldan 'das bdag la dbang bskur ba'i rab tu byed pa'i bka' drin gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ chags bral dang po chags pa che// kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od// rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i gnas// sangs rgyas brjod pa'i chos 'dzin pa// rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med// bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'chang*// cha med cha las 'das pa po// bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo 'chang*// oṃ hoḥpradzña u pā ya āt+ma kaṃ/ badz+ra sa twa ma hā mu dra dzñā na a bhi ṣe kaṃ me pra yats+tsha oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥphaṭa// dngos po med la sgom pa med// sgom pa sgom pa nyid ma yin// de ltar dngos po dngos med pas// sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o// chags rtog gnas skabs spyod byed bzhi pa 'dis// skye dgu'i bdag po chen por dbang bskur bas// skad cig gcig gis mngon par byang chub ste// 'bras bu sa ni bcu gnyis thob par shog /de nas dam tshig khas blang ba ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// sangs rgyas dang ni byang chub sems// dpal ldan bla ma khyod spangs nas// bla ma gzhan dag rmi lam du'ang*// srog dor nas ni bsten mi bya// gzhan yang de bzhin dus gsum du// g.yo sgyu med par nus tshad kyis// lus ngag sems dang gsum po 'di// gtso bo'i spyan sngar dbul bar bgyi/

/de nas rjes ni/ gtso bos (79)ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ sogs/ bka' drin gtong rag gi yon tu maṇ+ḍal dang*// deng nas brtsam te sogs brjod de dbang bcu gcig gi bdag 'jug ting nge 'dzin tsam gyi sgo nas blang ba'o// de nas gsum pa rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya'i mchod pa byed na skabs 'dir bya/ mi byad par gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ gtor ma bsham/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa// de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa// de'i steng du a las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum la gnas pa'i oṃ yongs su gyur pa las thod pa dum bu gcig pa/ de'i nang gi dbus su a las byang sems/ shar du i las rkang m-ir/ lhor ṛ las rak+ta/ byang du u las dri chu/ nub tu l̥ las dri chen/ rlung mtshams su l̥̄ las glang po che'i sha /dbang ldan tu ū las ba glang gi sha /bden bral du ṝ las rta'i sha /me mtshams su ī las khyi'i sha /dbus kyi steng du ā las mi'i sha /rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu// lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ sku rdo rje'i ngo bo// de'i 'od zer gyis ma dag pa'i rdzas rnams sbyangs/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sarba dharma su bi shud+dha swā bhā wa sarba dharmā na bi sho dha ya swā hā/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du nyi ma la gnas pa'i āḥgasung rdo rje'i ngo bo// de'i 'od zer gyis dag pa'i rdzas rnams spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sur+ya sarba dharma pra bo dha ka sarba dharmā na pra bo dha ya swā hā/ lag pa gnyis ka sbyar ba'i dbus su sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūm̐ thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo// de'i 'od kyis rdzas rnams kha dog dri ro nus mthu gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa 'bar bar gyur/

oṃ huṃ badz+ra a na la sarba dharma pra dī pa ka sarba dharmā na pra dī pa ya swā hā/ mkha' lding gi phyag rgya'i dbus su dus me la gnas pa'i hoḥyig ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis zag med ye shes mchog gi bdud rtsir byas par gyur/ (80)oṃ hoḥsarba dharma badz+ra a mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharmā nra badz+ra a mṛ taṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ brjod pa ni gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa'o// de nas mgron spyan drangs pa ni/ sangs rgyas yab yum sras dang bcas pa g.yog 'khor dang*// grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gis bskor ba'i tshogs ni// lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byed rnams dang*// mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol// 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ ha ha hi hī badz+ra bhai ra wa/ ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ ban+dha ya ban+dha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī hri da yaṃ huṃ hūm̐ pheṃ pheṃ phaṭa/ ces pas mkha' 'gro ma rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ nas kā maṃ gyi bar brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ shrī kā la tsakra bhai ra wa bhī ka ra ya/ sa pa re wā re bh+yeḥ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī pa/ a k+ṣa taṃ/ da dwa ma te te tsa ā ga t+ya sa pa ri wā ra shī gh+raṃ/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛ h+ṇan+tu/ khā dan+tu/ pi ban+tu/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ saṃ tṛp+tāḥ sarba sa twā nāṃ/ shān+tiṃ/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ rak+ṣaṃ/ ā pa ra ṇa gup+tiṃ kurban+tu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ rdo rje phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ uṣ+ṇī ṣa/ sum+bha ni sum+bha/ bigh+na an+ta ka /nī la daṇ+ḍa/ pra dzñā ān+ta ka ṭāk+ki rā dza/ pad+ma ān+ta ka /a tsa la/ ya ma an+ta ka /ma hā ba le bh+yaḥ gri gug gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ ā ka shā/ bā yu/ he dzaḥ u da ka /pṛ thī/ sā dhi te bh+yaḥ

ral gri'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ prah+ma/ biṣ+ṭu/ nai ṛr t+ya/ wā yu/ ya ma/ ag+ni/ sa mu dra/ ī shwa ra/ in+d+ra/ yak+ṣe bh+yaḥ rin po che'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ rā hu/ kā la ag+ni/ tsan+d+ra/ sūr+ya/ budha/ maṃ ga la/ shu kra/ bṛ ha spa ti/ ke tu/ sha ni bh+yaḥ pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ dza ya/ bi dza ya/ pad+ma/ karko ṭa ka /wā su ki/ shaṃ kha pā la/ ku li ka /a nan+ta/ tak+ṣa ka /ma hā pad+me bh+yaḥ 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ be tā ḍa/ bi kṛ ta mu kha/ (81)shwā/ kā ka /sū ka ra/ gṛ dha/ byā gh+ra/ ū lu ka /dzam+bu ka /ga ru ḍa mu khe bh+yaḥ zhes pa rnams kyis mthar/ sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ i dāṃ ba liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ āk+ṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te tsa ā ga t+ya sa pa ri wā ra/ shrī gh+raṃ/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛ h+ṇān+tu/ khā dan+tu/ pi wan+tu/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ saṃ tṛ p+tā/ sarba sa twa nāṃ/ shān+tiṃ/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ rak+ṣaṃ/ ā wa ra ṇa gup+tiṃ kurban+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ phyi mchod ni/ badz+ra bhai ra wa bhī ka ra ya/ sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra dhu paṃ/ badz+ra dī paṃ= badz+ra nai bi d+yaṃ= badz+ra ak+ṣa taṃ= badz+ra lā s+yaṃ= badz+ra hā s+yaṃ= badz+ra wā d+yaṃ= badz+ra nṛ t+yaṃ= badz+ra gī taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ badz+ra kā maṃ pra tī ts+tsha na maḥ nang mchod ni/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wa/ ha ya ra wa la/ da nya ṇa ma na/ gha dzha ḍha bha dha/ ga dza ḍa ba da/ kha tsha ṭha pha tha/ ka tsa ṭa pa ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bstod pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed// dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po// dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can// khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal// rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin// khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso// dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs he ru ka /rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dod don gsol ba ni/ /sde drug srung ma drug cu 'khor bcas la// mchod gtor 'di dang di dang me tog dang*// bdug spos snang gsal ma nyams bdag 'bul gyis// de rnams 'khor dang bcas pa tshur byon la// gtor ma 'di dag len cing gsol ba dang*// btung bar mdzad de shin tu mnyes pa yis// 'gro la zhi rgyas srung skyob sba ba rnams// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol// klu dang 'byung pos lus kyi khams srung zhing*// gza' dang phyogs skyong dag gi khams srung ste// zad par khro bos sems kyi khams srung zhing*// khams drug ldan pas khams kun rab srung nas// 'khor lo drug tu rlung sems rab 'ching ste// rgyal ba rigs drug go 'phang myur thob (82)shog

/bar 'dir chos skyong ye shes pa rnams la so so'i gtor chog ltar gtor ma 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍa ki nī bh+yaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ pra dī paṃ/ āk+ṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ sa pa ri wā ra/ shrī gh+raṃ/ ā gats+tsha tu/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛ h+ṇa tu/ khā da du/ pi wa tu/ sa pa ri wā ra ka /sarba sa twā nāṃ/ shān+ti/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ rak+ṣaṃ ā war ṇa/ gup+tiṃ/ ka ro tu/ i daṃ s+thā na/ t+yak+tā bā h+ya maṇ+ḍal bhū myāṃ tiṣ+ṭhan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gtor ma 'bul/ gzhi bdag gtor ma ni/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yul gyi bdag po sa pa ri wā rā ya/ i daṃ ba li/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ dhū paṃ/ pra dī paṃ/ a k+ṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ sa pa ri wā ra/ shī gh+raṃ/ ā gats+tsha tu/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gṛ h+ṇa tu/ khā da tu/ pi ba tu/ sa pa ri wā ra ka /sarba sa twa nāṃ/ shān+ti/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ rak+ṣa ā wa ra ṇa/ gup+tiṃ/ ka ro tu/ i daṃ s+thā naṃ/ t+yak+tā/ bā d+ya maṇ+ḍal bhā myāṃ bhamyāṃ ti ṣ+ṭhan+ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ khyi'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grong gi bdag po ā gats+tsha a gats+tsha/ shī gh+raṃ/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa/ b+duk+ta/ pitwā tṛ pa ti kṛ twā sarba sa twā nāṃ/ shān+tiṃ/ tsit+taṃ/ kṛ twā/ a pa ra s+thā naṃ gats+tsha gats+tsha swā hā/ spyi gtor ni/ oṃ phe badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ sogs nas/ mchod pa bcu gnyis/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ kyis phrin las gzhol ba'i bar byas la/ /steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bdud kyi phyogs gnas lha ma yin rnams mchog tu 'jigs byed dang*// mi yi 'jig rten dag na phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas khro bo'i rgyal po btsun mor bcas rnams dang*// sa 'og dag na gdengs can dbang po gar dag gdon tshogs mi dge dus kun tu ni 'ching byed pa// de rnams thams cad nyin zhag so so'i dus su mi shis 'jig rten kun nas skyong bar byed gyur cig

/ces shis pa brjod/ yig brgya'i mthar bzod gsol gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las/ gsang bar haṃ yig la khro bo'i 'khor lo (83)rnams gshegs su gsol// gtsug tor du aṃ yig la zad par gyi 'khor lo rnams= dpral bar am̐ yig la phyogs skyong gi 'khor lo rnams= mgrin par ṛ yig la gza'i 'khor lo rnams= snying gar u yig la klu'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ lte bar l̥ yig la 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ /ces gtor chog byas la/ 'khor lo'i mchod pa sogs byed na'ang skabs 'dir byed pa yin te/ de dag gi mthar rjes chog bya'o// gal te rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya'i mchod pa byed na/ sde drug gi gtor chog kyang de'i zhor la sbyar te chab gcig tu grub par byas na legs so// rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa bdun mchod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi mchod pa yang mchod chog mi 'dra ba re re yin pa'i phyir/ sde drug dang so bdun dang drug cu rtsa bzhi rnams gcig gi yan lag tu gcig shos nges par sbyar dgos pa ni ma yin no// 'on kyang rnal 'byor ma so bdun dang drug cu rtsa bzhi gnyis ka dus mnyam du mchod pa la rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya mchod pa ces grags shing*// mchod chog logs pa gcig tu 'gyur la/ sde drug gi gtor chog ni/ rnal 'byor ma mchod pa'i yan lag min kyang maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod kyi cha lag tu nges par dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ rigs brgya dang lhan cig tu mchod na thabs shes kyi lha cha tshang zhing phrin las mtha' dag sgrub pa la stobs che bar 'gyur bas kyang shin tu legs pa kho na'o// de la rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa bdun nam rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor ras bris la sogs pa yod na dgram/ gal te med na maṇ+ḍal zlum skor lnga la 'dri ba'am/ maṇ+ḍal gcig la lha sum cu rtsa bdun thod pa bzhi dang bcas pa'i tshom bu bkod/

de'i phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du tshom bu dgu pa re re 'god pa'am/ 'bru brdal ba'i maṇ+ḍal zlum po re la tshom bu re re 'god/ rigs sum cu rtsa bdun nam rigs brgya'i tsa ka li yod na legs par dgram/ yang phyi ma 'di maṇ+ḍal logs pa la bkod de maṇ+ḍal gnyis byas kyang rung*/ de'i tshe de la dbus su chos 'byung 'dri ba'am/ tshom bu che ba re 'god do// spyir rigs brgya'i 'god tshul la dkyil 'khor gnyis su byas nas gcig la so bdun dang gcig shos la dbus su dus kyi 'khor lo'am rdo rje sems dpa'// phyogs mtshams brgyad du gsung dkyil

(84) bzhin ma mo brgyad yab dang bcas pa dang*// rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi 'god pa'i lugs kyang yod la/ yang lugs gcig la gzhal yas khang sgo rkyang gcig gi sgo'i nang tshun chad du rnal 'byor ma so bdun dang*/ khor yug la rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi 'god pa'i lugs kyang snang ba dang*// yang so bdun gyi dkyil 'khor nyid la gsung 'khor gyi ma mo brgyad kyi mtha' bskor du brgyad pa brgyad kyis bskor ba byed pa'i lugs kyang yod pa de rnams kyang mi rung ba ni ma yin la/ 'on kyang 'dir 'og nas 'chad pa ltar gzhal yas khang phyi nang rim pa gnyis byed pa dang lag len la khyer bde bas bya la/ 'di ltar gyi tshe rnal 'byor ma brgyad tshar gnyis sgom dgos kyang ngo bo gcig pas rigs brgya'i grangs dang mi 'gal la/ thabs lha chen brgyad zhor byung yin te/ dur khrod gnas pa'i lha dang 'dra'o// des na gsung 'khor gyi rtsibs re re la lha dgu dgu 'god pa de ras bris sam tshom bu 'god pa la lag len cung mi bde bar 'ong yang mi rung ba ni ma yin no// des na lugs de dag gang mos pa zhig bya ba yin pas maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu 'god tshul yang de dang de las dpags te shes par bya'o// gtor ma bsdu na spungs gtor gcig gis chog pa sogs yod kyang rigs sum cu rtsa bdun la phyogs kyi dbye bas bcu gcig zlum gtor mtheb kyu can du byed cing*/ rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi la snod brgyad du zan ril spungs pa rnams bshams/ dam rdzas rnams dngos su bsre rgyu yod na rab/ med na gzugs brnyan dang ming yig tsam gyis kyang brgyan par bya ba yin mod kyi/ de yang ma grub na yid kyi mos pa tsam gyis kyang mi rung ba ma yin no// de dag gis mtha' bskor ram mdun du mchod pa rgya cher bshams shing*/ dbus su shing phor/ shar sogs phyogs bzhir nya phyis be ta thod pa rdza phor rnams mchod yon phyi snod dang*/

de'i rim pas mi lpags/ khyi lpags/ rta lpags/ ba lang gi pags pa/ glang chen gyi pags pa rnams kyi sder bza' bca'i snod du bya bar gsungs pa ltar dngos sam gzugs brnyan ji ltar 'byor pa bshams slar yang gong du bshad pa ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ gtor ma la oṃ āḥhūm̐ hriḥphaṭa kyis bsang ba nas/ a mṛ ta ku ru ku ru swā hā 'i bar gyi byin rlabs thams cad thun mong du bya/ sangs rgyas yab yum ces pa nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa yan chad kyis (85) gtso bo dus kyi 'khor lo sde drug dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul/ de nas maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ྷྐྵྨླྺྼྻཾ gi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las 'byung bzhi ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng du rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i steng rdo rje'i gur gyi nang du/ gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyi nang rim pa gnyis lha snam phyogs kyi mdog can du gnas pa/ nang gi lha snam gyi dbus su sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i nang du gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i nang du thugs kyi 'khor lo nag po rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo pad+ma ljang khu 'dab ma brgyad pa ste/ de ltar 'khor lo lnga ni sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ ral gri dang*/ gri gug gi phreng bas rim pa bzhin du bskor ba'o// bde chen 'khor lo'i pad+mar bzhugs pa ni// lte bar mi lpags gdan la g.yung mo ste// shar du khyi yi pags par dmangs rigs mo// lho phyogs rta yi pags par rgyal rigs ma// byang du ba lang lpags par bram ze mo// nub tu glang chen lpags par rje rigs mo// mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la snod bzhi ste// me ru rkang dang bden bral khrag gi snod// dbang ldan dri chu rlung du bshang ba ste// zla ba ltar dkar thod pa bdud rtsis gang*// thugs 'khor shar du lug lpags 'khar ba mkhan// lho ru sbyang lpags 'od ma'i gar mkhan ma// byang du rnga mo'i lpags par nor bu mkhan// nub phyogs 'dam seng lpags par phreng mkhan mo// shar lhor ra lpags gdan la thags mkhan ma// lho nub ri dwags lpags par chang 'tshong ma// byang shar bong bu'i pags par gser mgar mo// nub byang phag gi pags par phreng brgyud mkhan// de yi phyi rol gsung 'khor shar phyogs su// chu srin pir gyi pags par sha 'tshong ma// lho yi rtsibs la sbal pa karka ṭa'i// rus pa'i gdan la khur pa mkhan mo dang*// byang rtsibs rus sbal khog par gar mkhan ma// nub rtsibs mgar ra la tshe ma bum/

bsreg zang (86)mgron bu'i phung por rdza mkhan ma// srin por nya skam phung por smad 'tshong ma// dbang ldan dung dkar steng du tshogs mkhan ma// rlung phyogs sbal pa'i pags par nya pa mo// phyi rol sku 'khor dbang po'i phyogs rtsibs su// bsre yi pags pa'i gdan la lcags mgar mo// lho ru rgya skyegs mkhan mo stag lpags la// sre mong pags par til brdung byang du'o// srin bal mkhan mo nub tu dom lpags la// shar lhor 'bri yi lpags par smyig ma mkhan// lho nub lce sbyang lpags par shing bzo ma// 'byung por byi la'i pags par 'dreg mkhan mo// rlung mtshams sram gyi pags par ko lpags mkhan// phyi rol nam mkha'i 'khor lo'i shar sgo ru// go da'i pags par kla klo oṃ 'i ma// lho sgo byi ba'i pags par phyag dar mkhan// byang sgo spre'u'i pags par stag gzig mo// nub sgo sā li dzā ta ka zhes bya'i// pags pa'i gdan la gtum mo gdol pa mo// me mtshams ri bong lpags par smyon thabs mo// srin mtshams byi dur lpags par ro sreg ma// dbang ldan rtsangs pa'i pags par ri khrod ma// nub byang phyogs su ī shu ka pa shu'i// pags par bhi la li mo rnams 'khod par gyur// thams cad lang tsho ldan pa'i bud med tshul// rang rang las kyi mtha' la gnas par ston/ slar yang bsang sbyang*/ /rigs sum cu rtsa drug gi pho nya mo de rnams stong pa nyid du gyur// stong pa'i ngang las dbus su a dang rdo rje las rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje gri gug dgra s+t+wa/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ thabs bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin mi bskyod pa sngon pos 'khyud pa'o// bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab ma brgyad po rnams la ni// i dang ral gri las byung sgrol ma nag mo shar// ṛ dang rin chen las byung gos dkar dmar mo lho// u dang pad+ma las (87)skyes bdag ma dkar mo byang*// l̥ dang 'khor lo las skyes spyan ma ser mo nub/

gos dkar mo me'i mda' las bskyed par yang bshad pas ci bde bar bya'o/ /mtshams bzhir hī hṝ hūm̐ h+lāṃ rnams las byung ba'i thod pa bzhi'o// thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs la gnas pa'i lha mo ni// ā yig rgyud mang las byung shar phyogs sgra yi rdo rje sngo// hāḥyig rdo rje las byung gshin sngon mthon mthing lho// aṃ yig chos 'byung las byung chos khams ljang khu byang*// haṃ yig tog rtse las skyes drag spyan ljang khu nub// ai yig dar gos las skyes reg ma nag mo me// ā ru yig chad snod las skyes ro 'od ma'i dbyug /ma dmar mo srin// au yig me long las skyes gzugs ma dkar mo dbang*// a wa yig 'khor lo las skyes dri ma ser mo rlung*// de ltar gtso 'khor bcu gsum ni pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o// gsung 'khor rtsibs la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams ni// shar du ha dang gri gug tsar tsi kā nag mo// lho phyogs haḥdang gcu gzar phag mo me tog phreng dmar mo ste// byang phyogs haṃ dang rtse gsum drag mo dkar mo'o// nub phyogs hāṃ dang khab las dbang mo ser ba'i mdangs// shar lhor k+ṣa dang bum pa khyab 'jug mo ni gnag /bden bral k+ṣaḥdang gos ser dmar mo gzhon nu ma/ dbang ldan k+ṣaṃ dang rdo leb dpal mo zla ba'i mdangs// rlung mtshams k+ṣa dang nya las tshangs ma gser gyi 'od// ma mo brgyad po 'di rnams ni sa ga'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// sku 'khor rtsibs la bzhugs pa'i khro mo brgyad po ni// dkar min yaḥlas chu gri brtson grus ma ni shar// rab dmar raḥlas chos snod rmugs byed dmar mo lho// rab dkar waḥlas ku sha khengs byed ma ni byang*// gser 'od laḥlas dar srin rengs byed ma ni nub// yā dang smyug gdugs las skyes lcags sgrog ma ni nag /rā dang shing lham las skyes khro gnyer can ma dmar// wā dang spu gri (88)las skyes skul byed ma ni dkar// lā dang mthil l+h+wam las skyed 'od zer can ma ser// de rnams me srin 'byung po g.yo ba'i phyogs la gnas// thams cad kyang g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o//

sgo mtshams rnams su ྐྑྒྒྷྔ ྐྵྻྼྺླ ྷྻྼྺླ ྈྐྴྵny+p+sa ྙྫྷྫྪྩ ྞྜྷྜྛྚ ྨྦྷྦྥྤ ྣྡྷྡྠྟ rnams yongs su gyur pa las// ba lang ra las shar sgor khyi gdong ma ni gnag /rdza phor las skyes lho sgor phag gdong ma ni dmar// 'phang las skyes pa byang sgor stag gdong ma ni dkar// nub sgor pi waṃ las skyes ce spyang gdong ma ser// gsal shing las skyes shar lhor khwa gdong mig sman mdog /kin na ri las lho nub bya rgod gdong ma dmar// rma bya'i sgro las byang shar 'ug gdong chu shel mtshungs// shing mda' las 'khrungs nub byang mkha' lding gdong ma ser// de rnams ni zlum po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /'khor 'di rnams kyi phyag mtshan sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor las bshad pa ltar sgom pa'am/ bsdu na zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa kho nar byas kyang chog go / gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i nang gi lha snam la slar yang ma mo brgyad thabs dang bcas pa rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba skad cig gis grub par gyur pa ni/ phyogs dang mtshams su chu skyes dmar dang dkar po la gnas rnal 'byor ma/ zhes pa nas/ bar bus mchan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ces pa'i bar bstod chen las 'byung ba ltar ngag tu brjod cing yid la yang bsam mo// spros pa la dga' na 'di rnams kyang sa bon phyag mtshan las bskyed cing*/ rigs brgya'i rnal 'byor ma thams cad la ye shes spyan 'dren gnas gsum byin rlabs dbang bskur rgyas gdab rigs bdag so so'i bar du mtha' rgyas su bya la/ mdor bsdu na rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros// rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ hūm̐ baṃ hoḥhi gnyis su med par thim/ (89)khams gsum dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das// rigs brgya rnal 'byor ma tshogs bcas// rnam dag rdo rje dri mchog 'di/

/ces sogs 'don pa spos la mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ oṃ a ā i ī ṛ ṝ u ū l̥ l̥̄ swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥha aḥhaṃ ai ā ru.au ā l+ra swā hā/ oṃ ha haḥhaṃ hā k+ṣa k+ṣaḥk+ṣaṃ k+ṣā swā hā/ ྐྑྒྒྷྔ ྐྵྻྼྺླ ྷྻྼྺླ ྈྐྴྵny+p+sa ྙྫྷྫྪྩ ྞྜྷྜྛྚ ྨྦྷྦྥྤ ྣྡྷྡྠྟ swā hā/ oṃ yaḥraḥwaḥlaḥya ra wa la swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hi hī ya yi yaṛ yu yal̥ yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ k+ṣi k+ṣī yā yī yaṝ yū yal̥̄ yaḥswā hā/ oṃ hṛ hṝ ra ri raṛ ru rl̥ raṃ swā hā/ oṃ k+ṣ+r-i k+ṣ+r-i rā rī rl̥̄ rlu rl̥̄ raḥswā hā/ oṃ hu hū wa wi waṛ wu wā+-i w-i swā hā/ oṃ k+ṣu k+ṣū wā wī waṝ wū wal̥ waḥswā hā/ oṃ hl̥ hl̥ la li laṛ lu l+li laṃ swā hā/ oṃ k+ṣl̥ k+ṣl̥ lā li laṝ lū l+lī laḥswā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de ltar sngags tshan bcu gsum po re re'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar ba'i lan gsum gyis nang mchod phul// de nas stong nyid snying rje'i sogs dang*/ phra rab rdul gyi sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ gang gi zhabs ni dran pas kyang*// 'jigs pa bcu drug las thar mdzad// rdzu 'phrul dngos grub stsol mdzad pa// rnal 'byor ma tshogs rnams la 'dud// de bzhin gshegs yum rnam pa lnga// bdud rtsi'i snod dang bcas rnams dang*// rdo rje ma drug khro bo gnyis// thugs kyi 'khor lo la gnas dang*// 'chi med na chung ma mo brgyad// gsung gi 'khor lo mchog la gnas// sku yi 'khor lo bde ba che// khro mo brgyad po yang dag rol// rab gtum chen mo 'jigs rung rnams// sgo mtshams dur khrod 'khor lor gnas// brgyad pa brgyad kyi rigs byung rnams// 'jig rten 'phel zad las la brtson// dngos grub stsol ba'i gtong grogs mdzod// rigs brgya rnal 'byor gtso mo rnams// bye ba bgrang yas tshad med pa'i// rnal 'byor ma tshogs rnams la bstod// gang la thog mtha' dbus med

sogs ye shes lnga'i bstod pa gong bzhin gyi mthar rol mo'i sgra bya'o// de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ(90) zhes lan mang du brjod pa byin rlabs kha gsos nas/ oṃ a ā i ī ṛ ṝ u ū l̥ l̥̄ swā hā/ ces pa'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ ces sogs sde drug gi gtor sngags btags te phul kyang rung mod/ 'on kyang mkha' 'gro ma spyi gtor sngags nyid sbyor ba legs pas/ de nyid bod skad du sbyar na nor so chung bas 'di skad ces bya ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'khor bcas rnams// 'di ste gtor ma dri dang me tog dang*// bdug spos sgron me ma nyams bdag 'bul gyi// 'khor dang bcas pa myur du tshur byon la// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ'adir ni gtor ma zung*// bza' bar mdzod la btung bar mdzad du gsol// 'khor dang bcas pas sems can rnams la ni// zhi rgyas srung skyob sba bar mdzad du gsol// rang gnas bzhugs la phyi rol dkyil 'khor gyi// sa la gnas par mdzod cig hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzod swā hā/ /zhes btags pas gtor ma 'bul// de bzhin du sngags tshan gzhan rnams re re'i mthar yang gtor sngags de nyid sbyar bas 'bul te/ oṃ k+ṣl̥ k+ṣl̥̄ lā lī laṝ lū ll̥̄ laḥswā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams zhes pa nas/ bka' bzhin mdzod swā hā'i bar sbyar ba'o/ /de nas sde drug nang tshan phyogs skyong gi gtor ma dang*// rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma rnams sngar phyogs phyogs su bshams yod na phyogs kyi rims pa dang mthun par byed dgos pas// shar gyi gtor ma gnyis po de gtong dgos pa yin la// gtor ma gral bsgrigs su bshams yod na zlum gtor bcu gcig gi gral 'go ma de bzhag pa'i de'i 'og nas gral rim du byed dgos pas gral 'go ma'i 'khris kyi zlum gtor de dang*/ spungs gtor brgyad kyi thog ma gcig ste/

de rnams gtor bral nas blangs shar phyogs kyi stegs bu'i steng du bzhag la/ slar yang chab kyis bran nas 'di skad ces gyer ro/ /shar phyogs lha mo sgrol ma 'khor bcas la// khyi sha khug rta'i sha dang sha khams kyi// gtor ma 'di 'bul rlung gi bar chad sol// bsad bskrad dbye ba'i las kun grub par mdzod// tsa muṇ+ḍa la kum+bhir khrung khrung sha /rnag dang bcas pa'i gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi// ma mo'i (91)gdon 'joms rims nad zhi bar mdzod// shar phyogs 'gro rnams nad med dge bar stsol// shin tu stobs mar bse dang hor pa'i sha /rkang dang bcas pa'i gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi// shar gyi phyogs kyi bgegs kun zhi bar mdzod// sdang dang gdug can thams cad tshar chod cig /khyi gdong ma la go dha mig sngon sha /sna yi dri mar bcas pa'i gtor ma 'bul// shar gyi phyogs nas phrin las kun sgrubs shig /longs spyod stsol zhing dbang bsgyur dngos grub stsol// shar phyogs rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad la// so bzhi sen mo gsum dang thod dum gcig /dam rdzas bcas pa'i gtor ma 'di 'bul bas// bgegs rnams nyams shing 'dod don grub par mdzod// phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor dang bcas rnams la// mchod gtor 'di dang dri dang me tog dang*/
