ces pa nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/ /rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma de rnams phyi rol tu btang ngo*// yang de'i rjes kyi 'phro las rnal 'byor ma'i zlum gtor gcig dang spungs gtor gcig shar lhor stegs bu'i steng du bshams la 'di skad ces gyer ro/ /shar lho reg bya rdo rje 'khor bcas la// ra sha ngur ba'i sha dang bshang lam bcas// gtor ma 'di 'bul reg bya'i bar chad sol// 'gro la reg mchog ster ba'i phrin las mdzod// khyab 'jug ma la mgron bu khu byug bcas// bad kan bcas pa'i gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi// ma mo'i gdon dang rims nad zhi bar mdzod// shar lho'i 'gro rnams nad med dge bar stsol// lcags sgrog ma la 'bri dang 'ol pa'i sha /mchin par bcas pa'i gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi// shar lho phyogs kyi bgegs kun zhi bar mdzod// sdang dang gdug can thams cad tshar chod cig /khwa gdong ma la ri bong ne tso'i sha /bshang sgo'i dri mar bcas pa'i gtor ma 'bul// shar lho'i phyogs nas phrin las kun sgrubs shig /longs spyod 'phel dang dbang bsgyur dngos grub stsol// me mtshams rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor ma brgyad la// sen (92)mo gnyis dang so bzhi thod dum gnyis// dam rdzas bcas pa'i gtor ma 'di 'bul bas// bgegs rnams nyams shing 'dod don grub par mdzod/ /mtshams rnams su srung ma drug cu'i gtor ma gtong ba med pas skabs 'dir rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma phyi rol tu dor/ phyogs gzhan gsum dang phyogs mtshams gsum la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma gnyis dang gza'i gtor ma lho phyogs su bteg /lho phyogs lha mo gos dkar 'khor bcas la// rta sha sngags can sha dang khrag khams kyi// gtor ma 'di 'bul me yi bar chad= /dbang dgug bskyod pa'i las= phag mor karka ṭa dang srin bya'i sha /lus skyes phrar bcas gtor ma= /ma mo'i=

/lho phyogs 'gro rnams= /rmugs byed ma la stag dang bya rog sha /rgyu mang bcas pa'i gtor ma= /lho yi phyogs kyi= /sdang dang = /phag gdong ma la byi ba tsa kor sha /rna ba'i dri mar bcas pa'i= /lho yi phyogs nas= /longs spyod= /lho phyogs rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor ma= /so bzhi= /dam rdzas= /bgegs rnams= /gza' mchog bcu po 'khor dang bcas= /mchod gtor 'di dang = /bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/ /gtor ma gsum po lho phyogs su dor/ yang rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma gnyis lho nub tu bteg la/ /lho nub ro yi rdo rje 'khor bcas la// ri dwags phug ron sha dang sha khams kyi// gtor ma 'di 'bul ro yi= /'gro la ro mchog= /gzhon nu ma la nya dang kyung ka'i sha /srin bur bcas pa'i= /ma mo'i= /lho nub 'gro rnams= /khro gnyer can la ce spyang khyim bya'i sha /glo bur= /lho nub phyogs kyi= /sdang dang gdug can= /bya rgod gdong la gzug mo co ga'i sha /bha ga'i dri mar= /lho nub phyogs nas= /longs spyod= /lho nub rgyu ba'i= /sen mo gnyis dang = /dam rdzas= /bgegs rnams= /gtor ma gnyis po lho nub tu dor ro// rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma gnyis dang klu'i gtor ma byang phyogs su bteg la/ /byang phyogs lha mo bdag ma 'khor (93)bcas la// ba lang khu byug sha dang dri chu yi// gtor ma 'di 'bul chu yi dri// zhi rgyas gzhil ba'i= /dag mo la ni rus sbal so bya'i sha /ba spur bcas pa'i= /ma mo= /byang phyogs 'gro rnams= /khengs byed ma la ne'u le 'ug pa'i sha /rus par= /byang gi phyogs kyi= /sdang dang = /stag gdong ma la spre'u pha wang sha /lce yi dri mar= /byang gi phyogs nas= /longs spyod= /byang phyogs rgyu ba'i= /so bzhi= /dam rdzas= /bgegs rnams= /klu rgyal bcu po 'khor dang bcas rnams la// mchod gtor= /mdzad du gsol/ /gtor ma gsum byang du dor/ rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma gnyis byang shar du bteg /byang shar gzugs kyi rdo rje 'khor bcas la// bong bu bya gar sha dang mig khams kyi// gtor ma 'di 'bul gzugs kyi=

/'gro la gzugs mchog= /dpal mo la ni dung dang chu skyar sha /skra dang bcas pa'i= /ma mo'i= /byang shar 'gro rnams= /skul byed ma la byi la khyim bya'i sha /rtsa rgyus bcas pa'i= /byang shar phyogs kyi= /sdang dang = /'ug gdong ma la rtsangs pa ām+bha ri// mchan khung dri mar= /byang shar phyogs nas= /longs spyod= /byang shar rgyu ba'i= /sen mo gnyis= /dam rdzas= /bgegs= /gtor ma gnyis byang shar du dor ro// yang rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma gnyis dang 'byung po'i gtor ma nub tu bteg la/ /nub phyogs lha mo spyan ma 'khor bcas la// glang chen ri skeg sha dang bshang khams kyi// gtor ma 'di 'bul sa yi= /rmongs rengs gdab pa'i= /dbang mo la ni ma kar sreg pa'i sha /chu ser bcas pa'i= /ma mo'i= /nub phyogs 'gro rnams= /rengs byed ma la dom dang bya rgod sha /mkhris par bcas pa'i= /nub kyi phyogs kyi= /sdang dang = /lce spyang gdong la shā li dza ti dang*// ā ni la dang mig dri'i gtor ma 'bul// nub kyi phyogs nas= /longs spyod= /nub phyogs rgyu ba'i= /so bzhi= /dam rdzas=(94)bgegs rnams= /'byung po bcu po 'khor dang bcas rnams la// mchod gtor= /mdzad du gsol/ /gtor ma gsum po nub phyogs su dor ro// rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma gnyis nub byang du bteg la/ /nub byang dri yi rdo rje 'khor bcas la// phag sha mchil pa'i sha dang sna khams kyi// gtor ma 'di 'bul dri yi= /'gro la dri mchog= /tshangs ma la ni sbal pa bzhad dkar sha /zhag dang bcas= /ma mo'i= /nub byang 'gro rnams= /'od zer can la sram dang rma bya'i sha /lpags par bcas pa'i= /nub byang phyogs kyi= /sdang dang = /mkha' lding gdong la ī shu bhe ruṇ+ḍa// rtags kyi dri mar= /nub byang phyogs rnam= /longs spyod= /nub byang rgyu ba'i= /sen mo gnyis= /dam rdzas= /bgegs rnams= /gtor ma gnyis nub byang du dor/ steng du rnal 'byor ma'i zlum gtor gcig dang zad par gyi gtor ma gtong dgos pas khang steng ngam/

shar gyi shar du gtor ma gnyis po bteg la/ /steng phyogs chos khams rdo rje 'khor bcas la// rnga bong ngang pa'i sha dang bha gar bcas// gtor ma 'di 'bul chos khams= /'gro la chos mchog= /drag chen ma la seng ge bya khra'i sha /snying dang bcas pa'i= /steng gi phyogs kyi= /sdang dang = /zad par bcu po 'khor dang bcas rnams la// mchod gtor= /mdzad du gsol// gtor ma gnyis po steng du dor/ rnal 'byor ma'i zlum gtor gcig dang*/ khro bcu'i gtor ma nub kyi nub tu bteg la/ /'og phyogs sgra yi rdo rje 'khor bcas la// lug dang ba lang sha dang rna ba yi// gtor ma 'di 'bul sgra yi bar chad sol// 'gro la sgra mchog ster ba'i phrin las mdzod// sngon mor 'brog dgon khyi dang ljon shing sgra// tshil bur bcas pa'i gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi// 'og gi phyogs kyi bgegs kun zhi bar mdzod// sdang dang gdug can thams cad tshar chod cig /khro rgyal bcu po 'khor dang bcas rnams la// (95)mchod gtor 'di dang = /bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/ /gtor ma gnyis po nub phyogs thag ring por mdor sa yod na 'og phyogs su dor/ rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma zlum gtor gral 'go ma kha gsos chab kyis bran/ /dpal ldan rdor dbyings dbang phyug 'khor bcas la// shu kra me tog dam rdzas thams cad kyi// gtor ma 'di 'bul bar chad thams cad sol// las dang dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol// rigs brgya rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar spyi dang mthun par brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya/ gtor ma de yang khang steng du 'bul lo/ ༈ /yang tshogs mchod byed na'ang skabs 'dir bya ste/ tshogs rdzas 'du byas la/ oṃ pheṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri ga ga na swā bhā wa sarba dra byaṃ bi shodha ni/ sarba dra byā ni bi shwo dha ya hūm̐ phreṃ phaṭa/

ces lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥhriḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sogs gtor chog ltar byin brlab/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/ mtshan nyid rnam pa ā li kā li/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di nyid/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ /de bzhin tu sbyar te/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams= /phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams= /dam tshig gi rtsa ba mched grogs rdo rje spun grogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// oṃ ga ṇa tsakra= /oṃ mi 'bral snying gi gzhal med khang*// mos gus gzhom med pho gang na// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /bka' drin mnyam med dam pa rje/ ༈ /rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin bzhin gtibs// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa (96)bzhes// gnas khang 'di la byin phob la// tshogs rdzas 'di la bcud cig chug /'dir 'dus rnal 'byor bdag cag la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// rnam dag bde chen 'gyur med dngos// bde gshegs rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du// dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems// mkha' khyab dang po'i sangs rgyas nyid// rnam 'phrul sogs dang po drug kun la 'gre/ /spros bral dag pa e yig dbyings// rnam kun mchog ldan mkha' spyod nas// 'khor lo'i dbang mo sna tshogs yum// dbyings phyug shes rab pha rol phyin// rnam 'phrul= /rnam gsum srid pa'i gnas kyi mchog /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten sprul sku'i zhing*// sangs rgyas byang sems khro bo'i gtso// dkyil 'khor lha mo'i tshogs bcas kyang*// rnam 'phrul=

/rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// 'chi med gdengs can lha min skyes// 'khor ba gnas 'gyur ye shes kyi// srid gsum lha tshogs thams cad kyang*// rnam 'phrul= /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnam 'phrul mchog /chos rgyal rigs ldan 'khor bcas dang*// rtsod ldan dus 'dir rdo rje 'chang*// brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs kun kyang*// rnam 'phrul// sa la spyod pa'i 'og min mchog /bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad gnas mchog nas// sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba// gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yang*// rnam 'phrul= /gang la gang 'dul skur ston pa// phyogs bcu dus gsum 'phags pa'i tshogs// gdul dka' ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i// phyag brnyan pho nya 'byung po'i tshogs// rnam 'phrul= /bdud tshogs kun 'dul phrin las zhing*// dur khrod chen po bcu drug nas// bgegs 'joms 'dod don kun sgrub pa// chos skyong bstan srung tshogs rnams kyang*// rnam 'phrul= /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// rigs kyi cod pan ldems se ldem// dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru// rgyan cha mang po khra la (97)la// rol mo mang po di ri ri// glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug /'khor tshogs 'bum sde sha ra ra// sgyu ma'i rang snang rjen ne ne// gtad med rig pa sa la la// brjod med dbyings su tha la la// bde ma chen po khri li li// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsol// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// 'khor gsum gnyis su med par rol/ /de nas phud dang po bcad la/ gtor ma la yang cung zad bsgron/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul ba dang*// phyogs dus kun gyi mchod rdzas bzang rgu rnams// bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don tu bzhes su gsol/ /de nas las kyi rdo rje'i lag pa g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzung*// g.yas rtse gsum gyi phyag rgyas ka pā la thogs te/

steng 'og kha sbyor gyi tshul gyis bzung la/ /kye 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'dus pa rnams la the tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams// rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du rol/ /ces tshogs kyi gtso bo nas brtsams te rim pas bskor/ so sos kyang/ /bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes blangs/ slar yang tshogs rdzas gzhan rnams la bsre/ yang phud gcig bcad de/ phyed sngar gyi phud dang bsre/ phyed lhag gtor la bsre pa'i phyir logs su bzhag go / zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di rnams kyang*// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐// dngos grub rgya mtsho yon tan rin chen gter// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /zhes pa'i bar gong gsal ltar dang*/ /oṃ sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi yi bdag nyid dang*// tshad med rnam (98)thar chos kyi phung po dang*// dam chos ston pa 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams te// skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa 'bul// dus 'khor rdor sems shākya thub pa dang*// nus ma bum pa bcu dang rdo rje bzhi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dang khro bo'i rgyal// rang rang lha mor bcas pa rnams la mchod// gzung ma rnal 'byor ma dang 'dod ma dang*// tshes kyi lha dang gdengs can phyir 'dod ma// rab gtum gza' skar phyogs skyong zhing skyong sogs// byed bcas bye ba gsum gyi 'byung po mchod// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas dang*// mchod yul rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul// 'gro kun ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho la// mchog tu rol pas bde chen thob par shog /dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog

/dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun sel zhing*// rtog pa kun las nges grol ba// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /de nas so so'i phud bcad nas/ /oṃ āḥgu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa bh+yaḥbadz+ra nai wi d+ya hūm̐/ chang bu gnyis byas/ oṃ ha ri t+yai paṇ+ḍi ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ yang chang bu gsum byas la/ oṃ sarba ḍū tī ke/ a grā gra saṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de nas nang gi sbyin sreg gi dmigs pa gsal btab la so sor longs spyod/ lhag ma bsdus la bsang sbyang*/ /stong pa'i ngang las lhag ma'i gtor ma bzang zhing rgya che ba 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs dang*/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa swā hā/ len gsum/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te phyir btang*// drag sngags kyis mtshams bcad/ de nas rdo rje'i glu blangs pa ni/ dril bu'i sgra dang bcas/ kol+la i re ṭaṭha a bol+la/ mum+mu ni re kak+ko la/ gha ṇa kri pi ta ho badz+dza i/ ka ru ṇi ki a i ṇa ro la tā hi ba la khā dz+dzā ī/ gā ḍeṃ ma a ṇā bidz+dza a i/ (99)ha le ka liñtsa ra sa ni a i/ du dhu ra badz+dzi a i/ tsa u pa ma kats+tshu ri sih+la/ ka pu ra la i a i/ ma la in+dha na pa liṃ dzaḥ ta hiṃ bha ru kha i a i/ phreṃ kha ṇa khe ṭa ka ran+te/ shud+dha a shud+dhaṇ+ṇa ma ni a i/ ni raṃ su aṃ ga tsa ḍa bi/ ta hiṃ dza sa rā ba pa ṇi a i/ ma la a tsa kun+du ru pa ḍa i/ ḍi ṇa ḍi ma taṃ hi na padz+dza a i/

zhes brjod/ lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis// de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs shing*// spyan ma mig la sogs pa dag /bsregs pas ri bong can haṃ 'dzag /ces brjod cing don sgom/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi// rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la// da lta nyid du gnas par shog /ces smon lam btab/ de nas rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ gong bzhin byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ྩྪྫྫྷྙ badz+ra gan+dhe gan+dha a rtsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྩྪྫྫྷྙཱ badz+ra mā le mā la a rtsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྚྛྜྜྷྞ badz+ra dhū pe dhū pa a rtsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྚྛྜྜྷྞཱ badz+ra pra dī pe pra dī ba a rtsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྤྥྦྦྷྨ badz+ra āmṛ te ni wi d+ya pū dzī ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྤྥྦྦྷྨཱ badz+ra āk+ṣa te āk+ṣa ta phal ārtsa na ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྟྠྡྡྷྣ badz+ra la s+ye wasta ā bhar ṇa pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྟྠྡྡྷྣཱ badz+ra hā s+ye ghāṇ+ḍa ā dar+ṣa pū dzā+e ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྐྑྒྒྷྔ badz+ra wā d+ye bā d+ya pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྐྑྒྒྷྔཱ badz+ra nṛ t+ye nṛ t+ya pū dzā ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྶny+p+ṣ+shaྈྐ badz+ra gī te gī ta pū dzāṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ ྶny+p+ṣ+shaྈྐཱ badz+ra kā me sarba bud+dha bodhi sa twa nāṃ kro dha ā dī nāṃ badz+ra sū ra ta pū dzā ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes mchod rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ mchog sbyin rdo rje sogs kyis gong bzhin bstod/ spro na rgyud gzhan las 'byung ba'i rdo rje'i glu yang blang*/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ (100)khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/

brtse ba'i thugs rje/ nus mthu'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ spyir phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs shing*/ zhal bzhugs pa rnams sku khams bzang ba dang*/ khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba dang bcas pas thog drangs/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnas skabs su yang sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ ji ltar yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad 'bad pa med par 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bya ba la sogs gsol ba drag tu btab/ steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bdud kyi phyogs gnas lha ma yin rnams mchog tu 'jigs byed dang*// mi yi 'jig rten dag na phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas khro bo'i rgyal po btsun mor bcas rnams dang*// sa 'og dag na gdengs can dbang po gang dag gdon tshogs mi dge dus kun tu ni 'ching byed pa// de rnams thams cad nyin zhag so so'i dus su mi shis 'jig rten kun nas skyong bar byed gyur cig /oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs kyis shis pa brjod/ yig brgya mang du bzlas/ /ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis// nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod// gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pas// ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*// 'dir ni bya ba gang nongs pa// de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs// (101) rten yod na/ spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ rten med na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra mūḥ zhes mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ /gsang bar haṃ yig la khro bo'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol// gtsug gtor du oṃ yig la zad par gyi 'khor lo rnams= /dpral bar aṃ yig la phyogs skyong gi 'khor lo= /mgrin bar ṛ yig la gza'i 'khor lo// snying gar u yig la klu'i 'khor lo= /lte bar l̥ yig la 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ /zhes srung ma drug cu yang rang gi lus la bstim/ bris sku dang tsakli sogs rten rnams la brtan bzhugs spyi dang mthun par bya/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rang nyid la thim// bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams du ba la sogs lam gyi lhan skyes bde ba mchog bsgom ste// 'gro ba'i bla ma sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan sku ni chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag gnas// lha rnams mgo yi gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer tshogs kyis zhabs kyi pad+ma la gtugs shing*// dam pa'i lam ston nyin byed bzhin tu mun pa kun 'joms dus kyi 'khor lo nyid gyur cig /nyi ma dang bcas thub pa'i rigs rnams kyis ni shes rab ye shes thob par gyur 'di ji lta bar// rnam gsum srid par gnas pa'i sems can rnams ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i drin las e waṃ nyid gyur cig /skyes bu gang dag bdud kyi grogs kyis rtag tu mi bden mun par song zhing lam nyams pa// de rnams lam 'di thob nas rdo rje nor bu'i khyim dang ring ba min par 'ong gyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag rnal 'byor ma thob rab tu g.yo ba'i yid kyis gal te shi bar gyur na yang*// dpal ldan mi yi 'jig rten du ni rab mchog thub pa'i rigs su rnal 'byor ldan par skye ba dang*// sngon gyi goms pa de yis slar yang (102)ye shes rnal 'byor yangs pa dag ni kun tu 'dzin pa dang*// ye shes thob nas mi zad mchog gi gnas su rab bgrod slar yang gang du'ang skye ldan min gyur cig
